rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Search: Experiment with text ads, bidding, and campaign structures on Google, Bing, Baidu, Naver, and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.Display: Test, analyze, and optimize campaigns on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and others.Modeling: Analyze the vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop models we can use for optimization, and build dashboards for account managers.

rows.title: Business Data Analyst [AQ-20549]
rows.descriptionText:
Aquent is thrilled to partner with a leading global technology company that is revolutionizing how individuals and businesses manage their financial lives. This innovative organization is deeply committed to customer success, leveraging data-driven strategies and integrating AI into core workflows to enhance experiences and drive operational excellence across diverse international markets. Our partner is transforming how they generate insights and automate processes, setting new industry standards, and we are seeking exceptional talent to join their team.

Are you ready to make a significant impact on customer journeys and operational efficiency across global markets? This pivotal role offers the opportunity to not just analyze data, but to be instrumental in shaping strategy, enabling actionable insights, and establishing robust, AI-ready data foundations that scale across multiple regions. You will be at the heart of improving how this company measures and delivers customer success, directly influencing Customer Experience, Digital Experience, Service Delivery, and Supportability, all while working with groundbreaking AI-native analytics. Your contributions will directly enhance how customers interact with products and services, driving tangible improvements across the entire customer lifecycle, making a profound difference in how the company operates globally.

What You’ll Do

Build robust data foundations by collaborating with engineering to develop pipelines, enhance data integrity, and establish clear metric definitions and governance tailored for international markets.Develop data capabilities that function consistently across multiple regions and countries, while adapting to specific local requirements (e.g., regulatory, language, or workflow differences).Automate recurring reporting and validation processes to boost accuracy and efficiency, ensuring data structures and taxonomies are optimized for downstream AI consumption and model-readiness.Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide comprehensive visibility into key performance metrics, designing reporting that connects metrics across the entire customer journey rather than in isolated silos.Deliver deep-dive analytics by conducting root cause analysis to uncover drivers of customer pain points, digital adoption challenges, and operational inefficiencies.Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations that improve customer journeys, optimize staffing and routing decisions, and reduce escalations.Advance AI-native analytics by leveraging Generative AI tools to automate recurring insight generation, support AI-powered summarization and anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with intelligent automation.Enable experimentation and continuous improvement by supporting A/B testing and digital experience evaluations, analyzing performance outcomes, and quantifying customer and business impact.Provide baseline metrics, monitor results, and deliver insights to scale successful initiatives, including evaluating the performance and customer impact of AI-assisted and digital experiences.Influence strategy through compelling storytelling, communicating insights and trends clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment on decisions that enhance customer experience, digital adoption, operational performance, and supportability.

What You’ll Bring

Solid experience in Data Analytics or Data Science, with ideal exposure to Customer Success, Operations, or Digital Experience domains.Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development.Experience with dashboarding and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik, or similar).Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Spark) and ETL processes.Proven ability to communicate analytical findings in clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic priorities and tactical execution.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.Proactive and growth-oriented mindset, consistently identifying opportunities for innovation.

Stand Out With

Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support.Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing).Machine learning and Generative AI experience.A genuine enthusiasm for Generative AI and a growth mindset toward how emerging tools can accelerate analytical work, actively curious about how LLMs, AI-native workflows, and intelligent automation can enhance impact.Hands-on experience applying Generative AI to analytics workflows (e.g., automated insight generation, AI-assisted analysis, or LLM-enhanced data pipelines).Experience working with call center and/or digital support KPIs.BS or MS in an appropriate quantitative field.

Client Description

Our Client is a global technology platform that specialises in overcoming the world’s most important financial challenges. Their products and services are driven by artificial intelligence, and their accounting software is one of their most recognisable creations. Considered one of the top companies to work for, they are proud of their company culture and entrepreneurial spirit.

Aquent is dedicated to improving inclusivity & is proudly an equal opportunities employer. We encourage applications from under-represented groups & are committed to providing support to applicants with disabilities. We aim to provide reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, to those with a medical condition, disability or neurodivergence.

Other Requirements

This is a 10-month hybrid contract, offering up to £217.09 per day (PAYE). Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by COB Monday, 7th September. Due to the number of applications, we’re unable to get back to each candidate individually.

rows.title: Alpha FMC | Data, AI, & Digital Engineering Analyst Graduate 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Founded in London in 2003, Alpha FMC is the leading global consultancy to the asset management, wealth management and insurance industries, with over 1,000 consultants across 17 offices and 970+ clients worldwide. From strategy and operating model design to data, digital, and technology implementation, we partner with many of the world's largest asset managers, wealth managers and insurers.

At Alpha, you'll work directly with industry leaders, gain exposure to a wide variety of projects and clients, and develop skills that span consulting, technology, operations, strategy, and financial services. While many consultants build expertise within a particular practice area, our collaborative culture encourages learning across teams and disciplines. Most importantly, Alpha is built around its people. We pride ourselves on fostering a supportive, entrepreneurial, and close-knit environment where individuals are empowered to grow their careers, build meaningful relationships, and make an impact from day one. Through comprehensive training, mentorship, social events, and a strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and community, we strive to create a place where talented people can do their best work and build long-term careers.

What You’ll Do

This role covers two tracks: Data Engineering and Digital Engineering. When you apply, you'll be asked to select which track best matches your skills and interests. Both sit within the same graduate community and training programme.

DATA ENGINEERING:

Insurance & Asset Management

Alpha's Data & AI team works at the centre of our clients’ growth, enabling leading insurers and asset managers to build data platforms they can trust. We support clients across the public equities, private equity and real estate, secondaries, and London Market sectors, turning fragmented, hard-to-reach data into something usable for reporting, decision-making and AI. Our engineers work alongside client teams on live delivery, from pipeline builds through to agentic workflows, helping some of the biggest names in the industry modernise how they work with data.

Junior Data Engineer - A Day in the Life

You'll work alongside consultants, engineers, and client teams to solve technology and data challenges. Your day may include gathering business requirements, analysing data, supporting enterprise-level system implementations, building reports and dashboards, testing new functionality, and helping clients optimize their technology ecosystems. You'll gain exposure to cloud, data, and analytics platforms while developing the technical and consulting skills needed to drive transformation across insurance and private markets.

What You Will Learn

All new Analysts take part in our Alpha Analyst Training Programme, designed to give you a strong foundation in:

How to build data pipelines that move and transform real company data, using industry-standard tools (Databricks, Snowflake)The fundamentals of data modelling — how raw data gets structured so it's trustworthy and easy to report onPractical SQL and Python skills, applied to real projects rather than exercisesHow financial services companies manage data safely and meet regulatory requirementsHow to turn a business problem into a technical solution, working with people who understand the client's needsEarly exposure to how AI/LLMs are being used in data engineering

DIGITAL ENGINEERING:

Digital Engineering - A Day in the Life

As a Digital Engineering Analyst, you'll work alongside engineers, consultants, architects and client teams to design and deliver technology solutions.

Your day may include understanding business and user requirements, helping design technical solutions, developing and configuring applications, working with APIs and data, testing new functionality, investigating technical issues, and supporting the release of solutions into client environments.

You'll gain hands-on experience across the full software delivery lifecycle, from early design and prototyping through to development, testing and implementation. Depending on the project, you may work with modern programming languages, cloud platforms, databases, integration technologies, automation tools and AI-enabled engineering capabilities.

You'll also work directly with clients, contributing to workshops, demonstrating solutions and helping translate business problems into practical, scalable technology outcomes.

What You Will Learn

Software engineering and development principlesApplication and solution designCloud and modern technology platformsAPIs, integration and dataTesting, software quality and secure development practicesAgile delivery and the software development lifecycleAutomation and AI-enabled engineeringProblem solving and technical analysisStakeholder management and client communicationTranslating business requirements into working technology solutions

Alongside formal training, you'll learn through hands-on project experience, working with experienced engineers, architects and consultants and receiving ongoing support and feedback.

Who We’re Looking For

We're looking for highly motivated individuals who are excited by problem-solving, consulting, and the opportunity to make an impact from day one. Successful candidates will:

Be predicted or have achieved a 2:1 or above in a STEM discipline (ideally Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or Chemistry)Be available to start full time in August 2027Have a genuine interest in consulting and the insurance industryEnjoy solving problems and thinking analyticallyWill be proactive, curious and eager to learnCommunicate clearly and work well with othersBe excited by working in a collaborative, high-performing and sociable environment

Benefits

£40,000 base salary plus discretionary profit share25 days annual leave plus bank holidaysPrivate Medical Health InsuranceLife InsuranceIncome Protection InsuranceCritical Illness InsuranceSponsorship towards professional certification

We're committed to ensuring that financial circumstances don't limit access to our opportunities. As part of the interview process, you may be required to travel for an in-person interview and/or assessment centre. Travel costs of up to £100 will be reimbursed for this.

Applications will close on Sunday 8th November 2026 but please note that we recruit on a rolling basis so applications may close sooner.

rows.title: Intelligence Analyst II
rows.descriptionText:
About Crisis24

Crisis24 is a global, AI-enhanced provider of travel risk management, mass communications, critical event management, crisis-security consulting, personal protection solutions and global medical concierge capabilities, allowing prominent organizations, disruptive brands and influential people to operate with confidence in an uncertain world. At Crisis24, we go beyond mere employment; we pave the way to a realm where your skills become instrumental in shaping global security, guiding clients through a multifaceted and challenging landscape. Your journey with us will be deeply fulfilling, driven by a powerful sense of purpose and accomplishment. Within our thriving environment, you'll discover abundant chances for both personal and career advancement. Seize this moment to push your limits, broaden your expertise, and elevate your professional journey to unprecedented levels. Join the Crisis24 team today and be a part of something extraordinary where growth and impact converge.

More information is available at www.crisis24.garda.com

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking full-time GSOC Analysts to join an embedded Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC), providing 24/7/365 support to global operations. The GSOC supports the security function of a multinational client with a global footprint, requiring close collaboration with client stakeholders in a dynamic international environment. This role is suited for candidates with strong research and professional writing skills, and with previous experience in, or a strong interest in, global security, geopolitics, intelligence, and investigations. The role is primarily operational in nature, while also including investigative and analytical responsibilities to support security operations, incident response, and stakeholder reporting. The successful candidate will be a strong team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate work to tight deadlines. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment and communicating clearly and professionally with a wide range of stakeholders. This is an office-based role located at the Crisis24 office in central London. As the GSOC provides continuous 24/7 coverage, the position requires regular office presence and operates on a shift-based rota, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays. The ideal candidate will therefore be based in the London area or within a commutable distance of central London. Successful applicants typically have 1-4 years of experience.

Fluency in Arabic or Portuguese would be highly desirable.

What You Will Work On

Monitor global security developments through a range of sources, including internal reporting, stakeholders, open-source, social media, and intel monitoring platformsIdentify, assess, and escalate incidents requiring attention, and support relevant stakeholders in their responsePrepare and distribute security alerts, warnings, situational awareness updates, and travel security communicationsSupport emergency notification processes during incidents, crises, exercises, and other relevant situationsContact employees and travellers during emergencies and provide timely updates to key stakeholders, as requiredCoordinate with regional and global security teams in response to significant incidents requiring cross-regional supportSupport crisis management activities, exercises, and event security operationsProvide security and crisis management support to employees and business travellersAct as a point of contact for employees and travellers by managing security communication channels and responding to security-related queries and requests for supportSupport travel security processes, including the monitoring of submissions, approvals, and traveller tracking where requiredProvide pre-travel security advice and support to travellersCoordinate actions in line with crisis management procedures, evacuation plans, and other security protocolsSupport the maintenance of accurate records relating to sites, employees and travellers, ensuring information can be made available quickly during incidents, crises, or exercisesMonitor access control and CCTV systems, where requiredCarry out any other GSOC-related duties as directed by the GSOC Manager, Regional Security Directors, or key stakeholders

Who You Will Work With

The Security Analyst will be part of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) team, supporting the delivery of operational security monitoring, incident response, crisis management, and traveller support. The role will work closely with the GSOC Manager, Regional Security Directors, and other members of the client’s Security function, as well as employees and key stakeholders across the organisation.

What You Will Bring

1–4 years of relevant experience in security operations, intelligence, investigations, or a related fieldStrong research, analytical, and professional writing skills, with the ability to deliver clear, accurate, and timely output in a fast-paced environmentExcellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex issues clearly and professionally to a range of stakeholdersPrevious experience in, or a strong interest in, global security, geopolitics, intelligence, or investigationsThe ability to assess information, exercise sound judgement, and escalate issues appropriately in support of security operations and incident responseA sound understanding of security-related issues in a corporate or operational environment, and the ability to make balanced, business-relevant decisionsStrong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively under pressureStrong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a teamConfidence in using a range of systems and technology to support operational monitoring, communication, and stakeholder engagementA bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in a relevant discipline such as International Relations, Security Studies, Intelligence, Criminology, or a related fieldFluency in Arabic or Portuguese would be highly desirable

rows.title: Customer Insight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver exceptional customer experiences. As a Customer Insights Analyst, you will help create trusted performance visibility, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to actionable insights and drive the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. Working with stakeholders across multiple functions, you will transform complex data into clear, meaningful insights that help teams make smarter decisions with confidence. Our goal is to create clarity from complexity, enabling stronger performance and sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers' faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Use customer, loyalty and transactional data to uncover the behaviours, needs and motivations that influence how customers shop across our O+O (Offline & Online) channels. Transform complex customer and market data into clear, actionable insights that help teams make better decisions and drive business performance. Partner with teams across Customer, Commercial, Marketing and Trading to identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention. Monitor customer trends, market developments and competitor activity to identify emerging opportunities and help shape future strategies. Deliver meaningful analysis and recommendations that support the creation of more relevant, personalised and seamless customer experiences across our brands. Explore and apply new analytical techniques, technologies and AI capabilities to uncover growth opportunities, predict future trends and enhance decision-making. Champion a customer-first mindset, using insight and evidence to influence priorities, challenge thinking and help teams better understand our customers. 

What You'll Bring

Strong experience in customer, behavioural and market analytics, with the ability to identify customer trends, uncover growth opportunities and generate meaningful commercial insight. Confident storyteller who can communicate customer and market insights in a compelling way, influencing stakeholders and driving action through data-led narratives. Advanced SQL and analytical skills, with experience transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations that drive business performance. Strong understanding of customer acquisition, loyalty, customer lifetime value (CLV), member participation and the wider O+O (Offline & Online) retail landscape. Experience delivering customer segmentation, behavioural analysis and customer value insights that have informed commercial strategy and improved customer outcomes. Proven ability to build trusted relationships across functions, translating insight into recommendations that influence business decisions and align to strategic priorities. Hands-on experience using tools such as GA4, SQL and Business Intelligence platforms to deliver scalable analysis and present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

Are you passionate about marketing and delivering high-quality results? Are you looking to work on a wide range of marketing projects, and gain exposure to all aspects of the marketing mix? We’re looking for an intern to join our UK & Ireland Corporate marketing team, to help support delivery and implementation of the UK & Ireland and EMEA marketing strategy, as well as to provide operational support on the day-to-day running of the function.

You will have a busy, diverse, hands-on-role which will touch on all aspects of the marketing programme, from supporting planning processes through to implementation and delivery of key initiatives. You will work closely with the EMEA marketing leader, senior marketing executive, the UK & Ireland segment marketing teams, country marketing teams and the global functional marketing teams. You will also work with senior stakeholders in the business and key account teams, to help support strategic marketing initiatives across our key buyer groups.

A successful candidate is someone who will thrive in a fast-paced, professional team environment. This person must be able to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization and have the ability to juggle multiple, competing tasks and demands, with strong attention to detail.

What You'll Do

Support the UK & Ireland marketing team to ensure efficient planning, execution, and measurement of campaigns and initiatives as part of our UK & Ireland marketing strategy, working with the relevant functional marketing teams as required.Help to ensure consistency of ‘best in class’ approach to larger marketing investments, including assisting with setup and preparation of briefing calls and briefing packs.Support UK & Ireland corporate marketing team with preparation of presentations and regular reporting for EMEA business leadership and global marketing leadership, ensuring formatting and branding is in line with company templates and standards.Assist with digital and website content development and maintenance, including review of service, industry and biography webpages.Help to create compelling and innovative communications that meets various internal and external messaging needs, including drafting of client mailings, newsletters and social media posts.Support events management for internal team events and external client events, including conferences, seminars, roundtable breakfasts/dinners, and networking drinks/dinners.Assist with production of collateral, including proofreading and liaising with creative and content teams.Conduct market and competitor research to inform marketing strategies and activities.Assist with other day-to-day team tasks and ad hoc projects, including web and email enquiries, management of shared mailboxes, processing invoices, etc.Building social media assets and copy for any upcoming marketing activations.Organise upcoming tasks for the team and recording key updates in meetings.Work with segment marketing teams on UK&I marketing campaigns as required.

How You'll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

Basic Qualifications

What You Will Need to Succeed

Applicants must be completing a sandwich course at university and due to graduate in 2029Applicants must be available for this placement year from 6th September 2027 to 25th August 2028Applicants must be predicted a 2:1 or above final grade (or equivalent) for their degreeApplicants should be proficient in Microsoft Office applications (particularly PowerPoint and Excel)Ability to prioritise and manage time, workload and projects effectivelyStrong communication abilities, both verbally and in writing and comfortable communicating at all levels of an organisationWillingness to learn how to navigate a complex organisation and establish networks, with excellent stakeholder management skillsProactive workload management – Demonstrates the ability to prioritise tasks effectively, make time for important work, and proactively seek clarification or support when needed to keep work progressing and ensure deadlines are met.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in a marketing or corporate environment, ideally professional services or B2BPrior experience in events management, including online events.Experience in assisting with the creation and co-ordination of collateral both digital and paper basedExperience with using Eloqua (Oracle email marketing) or similar packagesExperience with using Salesforce (CRM Sales Cloud) or similar packagesLeadership experience desirable – Experience of taking on leadership or responsibility is desirable, whether gained through employment, education or extracurricular activities. This could include leading a sports team, contributing to a university society, taking responsibility in a hospitality role, participating in military youth programmes, volunteering, or other team-based activities

Our Application Process

The deadline for applications is 29th October 2026

STEP 1: Complete our online application form and submit your CV (no cover letter required).

STEP 2: Complete a pre-recorded video interview.

STEP 3: Attend a competency based In Person interview and written task to explore your skills and motivations in our Offices in London on the 25th of November 2026.

STEP 4: Attend a 2nd virtual interview with our senior managers between 1st – 10th December 2026.

STEP 5: Job offers are made to successful candidates before Christmas.

The team sits within Aon Reinsurance Solutions and provides clients (UK insurance companies, syndicates, and reinsurers) with advice on their underlying risks, and exposures to natural disasters such as windstorms, floods and earthquakes.

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our London office.

Aon is in the business of better decisions 

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

You will use machine learning and data science to contribute to the suite of proprietary analytical and efficiency tools developed by Aon UK team. Support client renewals, developing knowledge of cat and non-cat analytics, running all industry vendor models (e.g. RMS, Verisk, JBA, Impact Forecasting, CoreLogic). You will assist in the evolution of Aon’s UK Event Response solutions, calculating client’s potential incurred losses, post-event and on risk management basis. The role will also require you to work closely with Aon’s View of Risk advisory team to ensure best practice for catastrophe modelling for the UK, and liaise with Impact Forecasting and the development of their new catastrophe models.

The global nature of catastrophe modelling will also require you to participate in corporate practice groups and committees related to cat modelling, data science, ML, and cat risk management.

How This Opportunity Is Different

Comprised of enthusiastic and team-oriented individuals, the UK Property team is continuously looking for ways to evolve our clients’ understanding and view of catastrophe risk. Working very closely with our brokers, academic partners and our model evaluation specialists enables us to perform and draw from expert analysis and experience to make better decisions for our clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

MSc or higher qualification ideally in Data Science and Machine Learning.BSc in Geography/Environmental and/or Risk.(Re)insurance knowledge/experience ideal.

Skills

Strong computer skills in MS Office suite (skills in programming and machine learning are highly beneficial)Demonstrable coding skills in e.g. Python, SQL, R Experience of Geospatial mapping software e.g. ArcGIS / Mapping ToolsData visualisation e.g. Tableau or PowerBI

This is a high-growth opportunity for an analytical professional looking to build a career in Capital Markets.

Joining as an Analyst, you will gain hands-on exposure to complex debt facilities and see the full lifecycle of a securitisation facility. You won't just be checking data; you will be the one directly producing the institutional investor reports and operational deliverables that keep the capital behind a rapidly expanding leasing business flowing.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will be the operational engine of the team, owning the production of our investor reporting and helping ensure our funding facilities run accurately and on schedule.

Securitisation & Investor Reporting

Own the end-to-end production of institutional investor reports, facility utilisation tracking, and loan-level data tapes - you build these reports directly, not just support them - ensuring high accuracy and consistency across all deliverable

Fund Sweep & Cash Operations

Facilitate facility cash sweeps by validating rental fees, termination totals, and buyback settlements across securitisation structures.

Portfolio & Asset Tracking

Maintain asset lifecycle trackers (e.g. end-of-lease, defaults, and buybacks) to provide real-time visibility over reserve assets and borrowing base capacity.

Covenant & Trigger Monitoring

Monitor transaction covenants and performance triggers across securitisation facilities directly, flagging potential breaches to the wider Capital Markets team.

Audit & Reconciliation

Lead reconciliations between granular loan-level data tapes and facility summary reports, and prepare materials for investor audit requests, identifying and resolving discrepancies yourself.

Process & Data Optimization

Partner with Finance, Data, and Operations teams to validate data workflows in Databricks and drive scalable improvements across reporting processes.

What You'll Need...

A degree in Finance or a related discipline, plus 1 - 3 years of work or internship experience in finance, or in a role that involved working with large, complex datasets. You don't need a Capital Markets background specifically, but you do need real reps with numbers at scale.Experience building, auditing, or maintaining spreadsheet-based models and trackers to a solid working level. You understand how a single input error can propagate through a report, and you build in the checks to catch it before it ships.A demonstrated ability to take ownership of a reporting deliverable start to finish, not just review or QA someone else's output. The reports you produce are part of how that capital actually gets managed.

The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK.

What We’re Looking For

Provide data-driven insights to leadership teams and business partners by sourcing, validating, and analysing internal company data to support business decisions and identify opportunities for growth.Partner with senior leadership and business stakeholders to provide actionable analysis, highlight key risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making.Analyse business performance and present recommendations, providing clear insights into performance against plan and key drivers of variance.Work with leadership to identify key actions required to ensure plan assumptions materialise and business objectives are achieved.Prepare and report monthly financial and non-financial performance of Index’s business to executive and leadership teams, ensuring a high level of accuracy and delivering clear, concise reporting on schedule.Own the Net Revenue forecast for Index’s commercial teams, using data-driven modelling to support financial forecasting and budgeting, and provide variance analysis against targets.Support the development and implementation of initiatives to increase revenue, improve operational performance, and drive business value, leveraging Index’s internal systems and reporting tools, including Looker, SQL, Python, Confluence, and Salesforce.Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the organisation through effective collaboration and a customer-centric approach.Collaborate with teams across the globe and with the Commercial Analytics team to develop and share best practices.Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects and initiatives as required.

Here's What You Need

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Accounting with a minimum of 2-3 years of experience performing the responsibilities outlined above, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience;Strong oral and written communication skills;Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, experience with Looker, SQL or similar tools and languages highly preferred;Ability to conduct research, interpret data and translate data into insights. Ability to present data in a logical and clear manner to business stakeholdersComfort with ambiguity and a self-starter with an aptitude for defining and directing new processes;Project management experience and confidence to drive progress and accountability;Natural ability to articulate, present and tell a compelling story using data and data-driven insights.

The following skills and experience are considered assets for success in the role:

Experience working within the digital advertising and/or accounting industry;Experience in handling large data sets

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents Paid time off, health days, and personal obligation days plus flexible work schedules Competitive retirement matching plans Equity packages Generous parental leave available to birthing, non-birthing, and adoptive parents Annual well-being allowance plus fitness discounts and group wellness activities Employee assistance program Mental health first aid program that provides an in-the-moment point of contact and reassurance One day of volunteer time off per year and a donation-matching program Monthly town halls and regular community-led team events Multiple resources and programming to support continuous learningA workplace that supports a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment – learn more here

At Index Exchange, we believe that successful products are built by teams just as diverse as the audience who uses them. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunities. We celebrate diversity of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Additionally, we realize that diversity is deeper than any status or classification—diversity is the human experience. For those who show grit, passion, and humility—Index will welcome you.

Index Exchange welcomes and encourages individuals with disabilities to apply to work with us.

If you require an accommodation, please share the details of your request and any information how we can assist you with the hiring recruiter when they contact you. Index Exchange will make reasonable efforts to ensure accommodation requests are met throughout the recruitment process.

rows.title: Data Centre Operations Sevenoaks
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

We are hiring Data Centre Engineers for our client based in Sevenoaks in Kent with regular attendance at Maidstone site.

This is a secure environment requiring security clearance and as a result we invite applications from UK nationals who hold or are willing to undergo SC clearance due to account requirements.

The role will involve working both dayshift/nightshift hours and we offer a generous shift allowance as a result.

Due to frequency of attendance at both sites, we require candidates who can drive and have their own transport.

Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.

Position Objective

Visually inspect status indicators (LEDs) on Customer Equipment and report status to Customer

Perform a power-cycle of an item of Customer Equipment pursuant to the detailed, written instructions provided by Customer in the Intervention Request

Perform a visual inspection of power and cabling connectivity

Inspect all cabling for proper seating pursuant to detailed, written instructions provided by Customer in the Intervention Request

Test cable paths for conformance with performance standards pursuant to detailed, written instructions provided by Customer in the Intervention Request

Connect a Crash Cart (KVM) to assist diagnosis of failed reboots or power cycles pursuant to detailed, written instructions provided by Customer in the Intervention Request

Mount media in identified drives as part of system builds or diagnosis pursuant to detailed, written instructions provided by Customer in the Intervention Request

Activate hardware controls pursuant to detailed, written instructions provided by Customer in the Intervention Request; and Replace hot-swappable components pursuant to detailed, written instructions provided by Customer in the Intervention Request.

Functional Expertise

 Basic understanding of IT operations in a large organisation Strong loyalty with regard to data and DC facility security Fluency in the local language (speaking, reading and writing) Fluency in English (speaking, reading and writing) Ability to work precisely and quality oriented Flexibility and willingness to cope with unexpected problems and situations. A general technical orientation Competent and professional communication with a commercial attitude over the phone Capacity to understand and clarify customer expectations effectively Capacity to manage customer expectations and interactions effectively Basic understanding of server HW (console, devices ) Ability to handle various types of media, devices and libraries Generic media knowledge (will provide training for specific or customer specific equipment) Proficiency in Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office environment and general PC hardware Basic understanding of Networking

Preferred

 Data centre operations experience Familiarity with structures and processes Professional certification in a relative field A professional degree in a technical discipline

Please Note

To satisfy our contractual obligations with clients, the candidate will be required to pass standard Criminal Records checks. Additional background checks may be required by certain customers. You will also be required to agree to DXC’s Confidentiality, Non-Solicitation, and Conflict of Interest Agreements.

DXC Technology is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, race, colour, religious creed, national origin, marital status, sex, sexual orientation/gender identity, age (40 or over), or genetic information. DXC's commitment to diversity and inclusive selection practices includes ensuring qualified long-term unemployed job seekers receive equal consideration for employment.

Accommodation of special needs for qualified candidates may be considered within the framework of the DXC Accommodation Policy.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available here.

rows.title: Graduate data scientist
rows.descriptionText:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilitiesDesign and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.

What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

rows.title: Business Data Analyst [AQ-20549]
rows.descriptionText:
Aquent is thrilled to partner with a leading global technology company that is revolutionizing how individuals and businesses manage their financial lives. This innovative organization is deeply committed to customer success, leveraging data-driven strategies and integrating AI into core workflows to enhance experiences and drive operational excellence across diverse international markets. Our partner is transforming how they generate insights and automate processes, setting new industry standards, and we are seeking exceptional talent to join their team.

Are you ready to make a significant impact on customer journeys and operational efficiency across global markets? This pivotal role offers the opportunity to not just analyze data, but to be instrumental in shaping strategy, enabling actionable insights, and establishing robust, AI-ready data foundations that scale across multiple regions. You will be at the heart of improving how this company measures and delivers customer success, directly influencing Customer Experience, Digital Experience, Service Delivery, and Supportability, all while working with groundbreaking AI-native analytics. Your contributions will directly enhance how customers interact with products and services, driving tangible improvements across the entire customer lifecycle, making a profound difference in how the company operates globally.

What You’ll Do

Build robust data foundations by collaborating with engineering to develop pipelines, enhance data integrity, and establish clear metric definitions and governance tailored for international markets.Develop data capabilities that function consistently across multiple regions and countries, while adapting to specific local requirements (e.g., regulatory, language, or workflow differences).Automate recurring reporting and validation processes to boost accuracy and efficiency, ensuring data structures and taxonomies are optimized for downstream AI consumption and model-readiness.Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide comprehensive visibility into key performance metrics, designing reporting that connects metrics across the entire customer journey rather than in isolated silos.Deliver deep-dive analytics by conducting root cause analysis to uncover drivers of customer pain points, digital adoption challenges, and operational inefficiencies.Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations that improve customer journeys, optimize staffing and routing decisions, and reduce escalations.Advance AI-native analytics by leveraging Generative AI tools to automate recurring insight generation, support AI-powered summarization and anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with intelligent automation.Enable experimentation and continuous improvement by supporting A/B testing and digital experience evaluations, analyzing performance outcomes, and quantifying customer and business impact.Provide baseline metrics, monitor results, and deliver insights to scale successful initiatives, including evaluating the performance and customer impact of AI-assisted and digital experiences.Influence strategy through compelling storytelling, communicating insights and trends clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment on decisions that enhance customer experience, digital adoption, operational performance, and supportability.

What You’ll Bring

Solid experience in Data Analytics or Data Science, with ideal exposure to Customer Success, Operations, or Digital Experience domains.Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development.Experience with dashboarding and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik, or similar).Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Spark) and ETL processes.Proven ability to communicate analytical findings in clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic priorities and tactical execution.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.Proactive and growth-oriented mindset, consistently identifying opportunities for innovation.

Stand Out With

Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support.Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing).Machine learning and Generative AI experience.A genuine enthusiasm for Generative AI and a growth mindset toward how emerging tools can accelerate analytical work, actively curious about how LLMs, AI-native workflows, and intelligent automation can enhance impact.Hands-on experience applying Generative AI to analytics workflows (e.g., automated insight generation, AI-assisted analysis, or LLM-enhanced data pipelines).Experience working with call center and/or digital support KPIs.BS or MS in an appropriate quantitative field.

Client Description

Our Client is a global technology platform that specialises in overcoming the world’s most important financial challenges. Their products and services are driven by artificial intelligence, and their accounting software is one of their most recognisable creations. Considered one of the top companies to work for, they are proud of their company culture and entrepreneurial spirit.

Aquent is dedicated to improving inclusivity & is proudly an equal opportunities employer. We encourage applications from under-represented groups & are committed to providing support to applicants with disabilities. We aim to provide reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, to those with a medical condition, disability or neurodivergence.

Other Requirements

This is a 10-month hybrid contract, offering up to £217.09 per day (PAYE). Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by COB Monday, 7th September. Due to the number of applications, we’re unable to get back to each candidate individually.

rows.title: Catastrophe Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Aon is currently recruiting a Catastrophe Analyst to join our Global Reinsurance Specialty (GRS) Analytics team in London. The team sits within Aon Reinsurance Solutions and provides clients with advice on their exposures to natural disasters such as windstorms, floods and earthquakes. These clients include London market (re)insurers, and global reinsurers buying retrocession.

Comprised of hard-working and team-oriented individuals, the catastrophe modelling team is continuously looking for ways to evolve our clients’ understanding and view of catastrophe risk. Working closely with our brokers, academic partners and our model evaluation specialists enables us to perform and draw from authority analysis and experience to make better decisions for our clients.

Using both traditional catastrophe models (RMS/AIR/CoreLogic) and Aon’s in-house modelling platform ELEMENTs, we demonstrate the power of Impact Forecasting and external modelling solutions; to quantify the financial impact of natural and human-made catastrophes on our clients’ portfolios. This also includes developing tailored solutions for our clients to best represent their portfolios and loss experience.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

As a Catastrophe Analyst some of your key responsibilities will involve:

Analytics support (client reports, meetings and presentations)

Working with brokers and actuaries to understand exposures, review modelling results, explain modelling limitations and resolve issues promptly.Provide technical solutions in a digestible manner to both internal and external stakeholders at client /reinsurer meetings, presentations and within reports.

Catastrophe Modelling

Running client portfolios through natural catastrophe models to quantify the likelihood and severity of natural catastrophes for Client renewals.Undertaking sensitivity testing to help Clients understand impact of data quality, data and modelling assumptions and any planned portfolio change.Collaborating with academic and industry partners to validate and create innovative solutions for the (re)insurance market.Knowledge sharing of market and model experience with the wider team.Liaising and collaborating with other teams and offices worldwide.

There is a responsibility for working in accordance with the Aon UK Limited Risk Management Framework, and compliance with the Aon UK Limited policies, including participation in the management of risks (including completion of mandatory training) that may adversely affect the business, interests, or reputation of any Group Company

Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success

About you As a Catastrophe Analyst your skills and qualifications will ideally include:

Ideally 2+ years’ experienceWorking knowledge of vendor cat models (RMS and Verisk)Knowledge of Property and Specialty lines of business desirable (Marine, Energy, Terror, E&C)Understanding of the science of natural catastrophes and ability to validate and interpret the modelled loss estimates.Strong technical problem-solving skills.Good communication skills.Strong project management, with capability to work in a team, independently, working under pressure, multi-task, and ability to prioritise work effectively.Skilled with multi-relational database management systems and coding (SQL, R)Dashboard Analytics and GIS experience also desirable (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, ArcGIS)Knowledge of (re)insurance terms and business

How We Support Our Colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognise that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

We provide individuals with disabilities reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment in accordance with applicable law. Please contact us to request an accommodation on ReasonableAdjustments@Aon.com

Aon values an innovative, diverse workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking full-time GSOC Analysts to join an embedded Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC), providing 24/7/365 support to global operations. The GSOC supports the security function of a multinational client with a global footprint, requiring close collaboration with client stakeholders in a dynamic international environment. This role is suited for candidates with strong research and professional writing skills, and with previous experience in, or a strong interest in, global security, geopolitics, intelligence, and investigations. The role is primarily operational in nature, while also including investigative and analytical responsibilities to support security operations, incident response, and stakeholder reporting. The successful candidate will be a strong team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate work to tight deadlines. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment and communicating clearly and professionally with a wide range of stakeholders. This is an office-based role located at the Crisis24 office in central London. As the GSOC provides continuous 24/7 coverage, the position requires regular office presence and operates on a shift-based rota, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays. The ideal candidate will therefore be based in the London area or within a commutable distance of central London. Successful applicants typically have 1-4 years of experience.

Fluency in Arabic or Portuguese would be highly desirable.

What You Will Work On

Monitor global security developments through a range of sources, including internal reporting, stakeholders, open-source, social media, and intel monitoring platformsIdentify, assess, and escalate incidents requiring attention, and support relevant stakeholders in their responsePrepare and distribute security alerts, warnings, situational awareness updates, and travel security communicationsSupport emergency notification processes during incidents, crises, exercises, and other relevant situationsContact employees and travellers during emergencies and provide timely updates to key stakeholders, as requiredCoordinate with regional and global security teams in response to significant incidents requiring cross-regional supportSupport crisis management activities, exercises, and event security operationsProvide security and crisis management support to employees and business travellersAct as a point of contact for employees and travellers by managing security communication channels and responding to security-related queries and requests for supportSupport travel security processes, including the monitoring of submissions, approvals, and traveller tracking where requiredProvide pre-travel security advice and support to travellersCoordinate actions in line with crisis management procedures, evacuation plans, and other security protocolsSupport the maintenance of accurate records relating to sites, employees and travellers, ensuring information can be made available quickly during incidents, crises, or exercisesMonitor access control and CCTV systems, where requiredCarry out any other GSOC-related duties as directed by the GSOC Manager, Regional Security Directors, or key stakeholders

Who You Will Work With

The Security Analyst will be part of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) team, supporting the delivery of operational security monitoring, incident response, crisis management, and traveller support. The role will work closely with the GSOC Manager, Regional Security Directors, and other members of the client’s Security function, as well as employees and key stakeholders across the organisation.

rows.title: Alpha FMC | Data, AI, & Digital Engineering Analyst Graduate 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Founded in London in 2003, Alpha FMC is the leading global consultancy to the asset management, wealth management and insurance industries, with over 1,000 consultants across 17 offices and 970+ clients worldwide. From strategy and operating model design to data, digital, and technology implementation, we partner with many of the world's largest asset managers, wealth managers and insurers.

At Alpha, you'll work directly with industry leaders, gain exposure to a wide variety of projects and clients, and develop skills that span consulting, technology, operations, strategy, and financial services. While many consultants build expertise within a particular practice area, our collaborative culture encourages learning across teams and disciplines. Most importantly, Alpha is built around its people. We pride ourselves on fostering a supportive, entrepreneurial, and close-knit environment where individuals are empowered to grow their careers, build meaningful relationships, and make an impact from day one. Through comprehensive training, mentorship, social events, and a strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and community, we strive to create a place where talented people can do their best work and build long-term careers.

What You’ll Do

This role covers two tracks: Data Engineering and Digital Engineering. When you apply, you'll be asked to select which track best matches your skills and interests. Both sit within the same graduate community and training programme.

DATA ENGINEERING:

Insurance & Asset Management

Alpha's Data & AI team works at the centre of our clients’ growth, enabling leading insurers and asset managers to build data platforms they can trust. We support clients across the public equities, private equity and real estate, secondaries, and London Market sectors, turning fragmented, hard-to-reach data into something usable for reporting, decision-making and AI. Our engineers work alongside client teams on live delivery, from pipeline builds through to agentic workflows, helping some of the biggest names in the industry modernise how they work with data.

Junior Data Engineer - A Day in the Life

You'll work alongside consultants, engineers, and client teams to solve technology and data challenges. Your day may include gathering business requirements, analysing data, supporting enterprise-level system implementations, building reports and dashboards, testing new functionality, and helping clients optimize their technology ecosystems. You'll gain exposure to cloud, data, and analytics platforms while developing the technical and consulting skills needed to drive transformation across insurance and private markets.

What You Will Learn

All new Analysts take part in our Alpha Analyst Training Programme, designed to give you a strong foundation in:

How to build data pipelines that move and transform real company data, using industry-standard tools (Databricks, Snowflake)The fundamentals of data modelling — how raw data gets structured so it's trustworthy and easy to report onPractical SQL and Python skills, applied to real projects rather than exercisesHow financial services companies manage data safely and meet regulatory requirementsHow to turn a business problem into a technical solution, working with people who understand the client's needsEarly exposure to how AI/LLMs are being used in data engineering

DIGITAL ENGINEERING:

Digital Engineering - A Day in the Life

As a Digital Engineering Analyst, you'll work alongside engineers, consultants, architects and client teams to design and deliver technology solutions.

Your day may include understanding business and user requirements, helping design technical solutions, developing and configuring applications, working with APIs and data, testing new functionality, investigating technical issues, and supporting the release of solutions into client environments.

You'll gain hands-on experience across the full software delivery lifecycle, from early design and prototyping through to development, testing and implementation. Depending on the project, you may work with modern programming languages, cloud platforms, databases, integration technologies, automation tools and AI-enabled engineering capabilities.

You'll also work directly with clients, contributing to workshops, demonstrating solutions and helping translate business problems into practical, scalable technology outcomes.

What You Will Learn

Software engineering and development principlesApplication and solution designCloud and modern technology platformsAPIs, integration and dataTesting, software quality and secure development practicesAgile delivery and the software development lifecycleAutomation and AI-enabled engineeringProblem solving and technical analysisStakeholder management and client communicationTranslating business requirements into working technology solutions

Alongside formal training, you'll learn through hands-on project experience, working with experienced engineers, architects and consultants and receiving ongoing support and feedback.

Who We’re Looking For

We're looking for highly motivated individuals who are excited by problem-solving, consulting, and the opportunity to make an impact from day one. Successful candidates will:

Be predicted or have achieved a 2:1 or above in a STEM discipline (ideally Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or Chemistry)Be available to start full time in August 2027Have a genuine interest in consulting and the insurance industryEnjoy solving problems and thinking analyticallyWill be proactive, curious and eager to learnCommunicate clearly and work well with othersBe excited by working in a collaborative, high-performing and sociable environment

Benefits

£40,000 base salary plus discretionary profit share25 days annual leave plus bank holidaysPrivate Medical Health InsuranceLife InsuranceIncome Protection InsuranceCritical Illness InsuranceSponsorship towards professional certification

We're committed to ensuring that financial circumstances don't limit access to our opportunities. As part of the interview process, you may be required to travel for an in-person interview and/or assessment centre. Travel costs of up to £100 will be reimbursed for this.

Applications will close on Sunday 8th November 2026 but please note that we recruit on a rolling basis so applications may close sooner.

rows.title: Climate Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Do you want to help the insurance market understand the impacts of climate change? Do you enjoy applying academic science to industry applications? This role will be tackling both of these questions, and more, as part of a wider team addressing climate change topics! This is a hybrid role, working virtually as well as out of our London office.

 This is dependent on role and aligns with in country smart working policy. 

Aon is in the business of better decisions 

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

This role will be focussed on developing solutions to our current risk models to account for climate change, working across Aon to deliver climate analytics and help the business understand the impacts of climate change, and engaging with clients to deliver our climate analytics.

A Typical Day Will Involve

Analysing climate model data, as well as observation data, as part of specific projects investigating the impact of climate change.Running our risk models and adjusting them to account for climate change.Producing reports and presentations summarising the key results and presenting these to clients.Staying up to date on the latest academic publications on climate science through academic engagements.Keeping up to date with new solutions available within the market.

How This Opportunity Is Different

Climate analytics within the insurance market have gone beyond top-level conversations about how climate change may impact the industry. At Aon, we’re developing solutions and providing analytics that address specific needs from clients in regard to climate change, creating adjustments to current models and translating the latest academic science, data and research into practical applications for the insurance industry.

This role will be within the Climate Analytics team in London but also the wider global Climate Risk Advisory team. You will work across the business, with a range of clients and colleagues. You will need to collaborate with colleagues in different offices, working in different business areas, as well as with others within the market. You will also need to work with academia and third-party providers.

Our work feeds directly into the risk models that form the basis of the insurance industry, with the results of our work being presented both to the client and incorporated into our conversations with clients regarding their future risk transfer needs. We sit within Risk Solutions, collaborating closely with brokers and client leaders.

Key Skills Include

Skills and experience that will lead to success

A deep understanding of climate science, models and academic work.Programming abilities (R/Python) that allow for the analysis of climate data.An ability to translate complex academic work and analytics to those without a scientific background.A willingness to work as part of a team delivering a range of solutions, as well as responding to client requests.

How We Support Our Colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognise that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

We provide individuals with disabilities reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment in accordance with applicable law. Please contact us to request an accommodation on ReasonableAdjustments@Aon.com

Aon values an innovative, diverse workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

 Dependant on regional requirements, please include specific benefits where applicable and relevant accommodation criteria and enhanced equal opportunities statement.
