rows.title: Master Data Analyst (12-month contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Master Data Analyst (12-month contract) to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food maker with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. Founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry across three major geographic regions.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here's The Scoop – Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Master Data Analyst (12-month contract) to join our Project Management Office (PMO).

In a fast-paced Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) environment, clean, consistent, and structured data is the foundation of efficient operations, accurate reporting, and successful new product launches.

Reporting directly to the PMO Director and working in close partnership with the Master Data Manager, this "hands-on" role will be responsible for the accuracy, quality, and lifecycle management of our critical business data domains.

You will act as the bridge between strategic project milestones (such as New Product Introductions) and the technical execution of Master Data Management (MDM), ensuring that Champion operates with one source of truth.

The Master Data Analyst (12-month contract) works out of our Corporate office in Louisville (CO), Nashville (TN) or Edmonton (AB) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

What a typical day looks like:

Master Data Maintenance & Quality Assurance 

Data Creation & Management: Execute the hands-on creation, maintenance, and modification of master data records across key domains, with a primary focus on the Product domain (product catalogs, packaging specs, formulation recipes, and hierarchies) as well as Customer, Supplier/Vendor, and Location domains.Data Discrepancy Resolution: Actively troubleshoot data entry errors and resolve naming inconsistencies (e.g., standardizing brand nomenclature like "Six Fish" vs. "6 Fish", "Recipe" vs. "RCP") to prevent downstream operational issues.Auditing & Cleansing: Perform regular data audits and execute cleansing procedures for obsolete, duplicate, or unused data to maintain a clean database and prevent team members from losing valuable time "hunting" for the right information.Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Ensure all data-entry activities strictly adhere to established data standards, workflows, controls, and policies defined by the Master Data Manager and Finance Governance.

 PMO Integration & Cross-Functional Alignment

Project Support & NPI Readiness: Collaborate with PMO Project Managers to track and coordinate master data readiness for New Product Introductions (NPI), stage-gate processes, and supply chain transitions.Workflow Coordination: Facilitate cross-functional data collection workflows. Partner closely with Business Data Stewards in Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure correct data inputs are gathered and uploaded in alignment with project timelines.System Integration Support: Assist the Master Data Manager and IT teams in gathering requirements, defining data structures, and ensuring smooth, automated master data integration across multiple enterprise systems (ERP, PLM, MDM tools).Progress Reporting: Prepare regular status reports and dashboards regarding data readiness, quality metrics, and bottleneck areas to the PMO and Master Data Manager.

Support & Enablement

End-User Training: Assist in developing training materials and provide ongoing support to business users and Data Stewards on data management workflows and standard practices.Continuous Improvement: Identify and recommend areas for data quality improvements, process simplification, and automation opportunities within the PMO and broader business units

What are we looking for?

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Project Management, or a related field.Experience: 2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Master Data Specialist, or Product Information Analyst, ideally within a CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) or manufacturing company.Domain Knowledge: Foundational understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts (data governance, stewards, owners, schemas, and hierarchies).

Skills & Attributes:

Meticulous Attention to Detail: A natural instinct to spot and fix data discrepancies.Collaboration & Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills to follow up with team members across different departments and hold others accountable for data deadlines.Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive attitude that thrives on resolving "rabbit holes" of data confusion and building efficient, standardized processes.Project Management Orientation: Ability to manage multiple priorities and align data-related tasks with strict project timelines.

Systems & Tools

Strong proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, JD Edwards) and PLM/MDM software. Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data cleaning functions).Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) or PMO collaboration software is a plus

What can you expect from Champion?

Safety: a strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.

Earnings:

US: Salary range from USD$78,000 to USD$107,000, 401k with Company, and donation matching.

Canada: Salary range from CAD: 86,000 to CAD$115,000, RRSP with Company matching.

Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistance Programs to meet your individual or family needs.

Continuing Education: In House & Online Learning & Development, as well as an Education Assistance Program.

Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.

Other Perks: Free Bag of Premium Pet Food each month, Free Parking and more!

What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, if eligible, including variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Eligibility for these additional elements depend on the position offered and the employee’s work schedule (i.e., part-time schedule, store associate). rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

WHBC - WINTON HILL BUS CENTER

Job Description

Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

This internship is specifically designed for individuals working towards a PhD who are developing proficiency in their field. As an intern or co-op in management, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in a supportive environment. This is a 12-week paid internship, designed to provide you with a solid foundation for future career growth. The internship will take place from May (potentially early June) to August of 2027. Join us at P&G, where your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of consumer products!

The Opportunity:

P&G has an opportunity for a PhD intern to work in our Feminine Care business working in the space of Data Scientist & Gen AI. This role leverages current Gen AI technology, multi-discipline knowledge and R&D product innovation cycle, especially by leveraging data and digital approaches. The candidate will create Gen AI tool as co-pilot to guide and influence technical project direction and enable fast problem solving by leveraging collective knowledge in our data & modeling eco-system. The candidate should demonstrate strong scientific/engineering skills through advance model development and application development.

You will investigate how active learning and sequential experimentation can accelerate learning in R&D. Using historical consumer study and simulation datasets, the project will evaluate whether uncertainty estimates can identify the most informative next study, measurement, or simulation to perform. Rather than exploring the design space uniformly, the goal is to prioritize experiments that are expected to provide the greatest reduction in uncertainty and the highest learning value. This work will treat consumer studies and first-principles simulations as two applications of the same underlying problem: how to allocate experimentation resources more efficiently.

The Ideal Candidate: 

Experience with entrepreneurial/startups and/or industrial experience are strongly preferred. Has strong ownership & self-leadership skills to understand the business objective and technical problem to be solved.Has experience collaborating with multi-functional teams.Has the ability to recognize opportunities for capabilities or technologies that can be reapplied across programs.Can independently work project priorities, multi-task, and handle a wide variety of complex, non-routine/routine tasks in a fast-paced environment. 

Key Responsibilities:

Using historical consumer study and simulation datasets to evaluate uncertaintyIdentify next study, simulation, and measurement based on reduction of uncertaintyOptimize experimental resourcesCreate a prototype work process to demonstrate success

Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Education: Working towards a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mechanical Engineering, Computational Physics, Computational Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or Data Science. Active learning / sequential experimental design — central to recommending the next most informative consumer study or simulation. Probabilistic machine learning / Bayesian statistics — needed to represent prediction uncertainty and update confidence as evidence arrives. Surrogate modeling — needed for both consumer-response prediction and simulation-response approximation. Python — required for model development, simulation, and analysis; PyTorch, scikit-learn, BoTorch, GPyTorch, or similar tools would be useful. Experimental design and model evaluation — needed to compare active learning policies against baselines and define success metrics. Available to work a 12-week internship from May/early June to August in the summer of 2027, and at least 3 days/week onsite at Winton Hill Business Center. 

Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

Bayesian optimization Multi-armed bandits or reinforcement learning Uncertainty quantification Gaussian processes, evidential models, Bayesian neural networks, or ensembles Scientific computing CFD / FEA familiarity, if using first-principles simulation examples Generative AI / AI-agent prototyping, but only as a communication layer, not the core research contribution

rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

Are you an Engineer who wants to work on a large scale to drive significant business impact? Procter & Gamble is looking for people interested in different types of engineering: software, platform, or network to apply innovative technologies to business problems that require out of the box thinking. The work you will be doing could be anything from building data pipelines to feed Machine Learning models on petabytes of data that serve predictions globally, to building out consumer facing Internet of Things (IoT) Platforms, to building serverless applications to drive business needs from HR to Information Security. Regardless of the team, as a P&G IT Engineer you are someone who solves business problems using technology. 

You are primarily a problem solver, comfortable writing code, debugging, and working hands-on. You can independently identify problems and their solutions. You are interested in continuously learning and developing your own breadth and depth of technical knowledge and its application. You have a solid foundation in Computer Science fundamentals. You take pride in the quality of solutions that you build and strive to make everything automated, testable, and scalable. You work collaboratively with others on your team and across different teams, are interested learning from others, and have a desire to share your knowledge with the broader internal engineering community. 

 

Example Responsibilities by Role Type:  

Software Engineering: Translate system requirements and user stories into scalable, maintainable application designs and high-quality code. Develop, test, and validate solutions to ensure functionality, reliability, and performance. Implement and support code throughout the software development lifecycle, leveraging CI/CD tools for efficient integration and deployment. Collaborate closely with product, operations, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with dependent systems and services. Contribute to application architecture and technical design decisions as appropriate. Stay current with emerging software development practices, technologies, security standards, and vulnerability management.Network Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain network infrastructure solutions that support business objectives. Serve as an escalation point for critical network issues and play a key role in strategic projects, collaborating with operations teams and IT stakeholders to ensure reliable service and successful outcomes.Platform Engineering: Manage cloud platforms using configuration management to deliver secure, scalable, and automated solutions. Drive platform standards, resolve cloud and security incidents, and continuously improve engineering maturity across cloud services. Lead innovation through proof-of-concept initiatives, evaluate third-party cloud solutions, collaborate with service providers and product teams, and contribute to the Cloud Community of Practice to promote knowledge sharing, reusable code, and consistent standards across P&G.

 

As an intern, you will experience a subset of the above responsibilities

You must be available during the summer of 2027 for a 12 week internship from mid/late May through early August. Preferred: 

A history of solving hard problems with creative solutions.  Experience with Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.   Understand CI/CD and DevSecOps philosophies.

rows.descriptionText:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

Ralph Lauren is seeking a strategic, innovative, and execution-oriented Head of AI Strategy & Product Management to lead the development and scaling of the company’s enterprise AI strategy, product portfolio, and operating model through the AI Center of Excellence (CoE). This role will define how artificial intelligence capabilities are translated into scalable products, platforms, and enterprise solutions that drive measurable business value across consumer, commercial, operational, and corporate domains.

This leader will sit at the intersection of AI strategy, product management, enterprise transformation, and business innovation — responsible for shaping Ralph Lauren’s enterprise AI roadmap, governance frameworks, prioritization models, and product operating practices. The role will ensure AI initiatives align to enterprise priorities, organizational readiness, and long-term strategic differentiation while accelerating adoption and value realization globally.

This role requires a leader who combines strategic vision, product management expertise, operational rigor, commercial thinking, and AI fluency with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and build scalable frameworks that enable enterprise-wide transformation.

,

 Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmap Define and maintain Ralph Lauren’s enterprise AI strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmap aligned to business and technology objectives. Identify and evaluate opportunities where AI can create measurable value across consumer, merchandising, operations, supply chain, marketing, and corporate functions. Deliver ongoing market intelligence on emerging AI technologies, competitors, platforms, and industry trends to inform enterprise strategy and investment decisions. Establish enterprise AI success metrics, KPIs, and value realization frameworks tied to business outcomes, operational efficiency, and adoption. Partner with executive leadership to align AI priorities and ensure strategic consistency across the organization. AI Product Management & Portfolio Leadership Establish and lead enterprise AI product management practices, governance models, and lifecycle management standards. Build and manage a prioritized portfolio of AI initiatives balancing innovation, scalability, feasibility, business value, and organizational readiness. Partner with Engineering, Data and Architecture teams to develop scalable AI-enabled products, platforms, intelligent agents, and enterprise solutions. Define frameworks for AI intake, prioritization, experimentation, launch, adoption, optimization, and lifecycle management. Drive alignment on AI roadmaps, funding, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across global teams. AI Operating Model & Governance Design and operationalize enterprise AI governance frameworks, operating models, and prioritization processes. Define standards and guardrails for responsible AI, risk management, security, compliance, and model governance. Translate enterprise AI strategy into scalable operating structures including pods, governance cadences, delivery models, and organizational workflows. Partner with Finance, Portfolio Management, and Technology leadership on AI investment planning, funding allocation, and resource prioritization. Develop reusable playbooks, frameworks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI maturity and adoption globally. AI Innovation & Transformation Lead strategic exploration of emerging AI technologies and evaluate their applicability to Ralph Lauren’s business and operating model. Identify opportunities to improve productivity, automation, decision-making, and business performance through AI-enabled capabilities. Support innovation programs, experimentation initiatives, and pilot programs that accelerate enterprise AI transformation. Drive cross-functional collaboration to scale successful AI solutions into sustainable enterprise capabilities. Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on AI trends, opportunities, risks, and transformation priorities. Leadership & Organizational Development Build and lead a high-performing global AI Strategy & Product Management organization. Attract, develop, and retain top AI, product, and strategy talent. Foster strong collaboration across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Operations, and Corporate teams. Promote a culture of innovation, agility, accountability, experimentation, and responsible AI adoption.

Establish clear governance, communication, and decision-making practices across the AI CoE ecosystem.

Salary range: $182,000 - $370,425 annually,

Experience & Education

 10+ years of experience in AI strategy, digital product management, enterprise transformation, management consulting, or related leadership roles. Proven experience building and scaling enterprise AI products, platforms, operating models, or transformation initiatives. Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional programs across Product, Technology, Operations, Data, and Business organizations. Experience operating within large global organizations and matrixed stakeholder environments preferred.

Leadership & Strategic Skills

 Strong strategic thinking, operating model design, and enterprise transformation experience. Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership and drive alignment across complex organizations. Executive-level communication, storytelling, and presentation capabilities. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect AI investments to measurable business outcomes. Proven ability to balance innovation with operational rigor, governance, scalability, and execution.

Technical & Functional Expertise

 Lead the AI product strategy and operating model, translating enterprise AI priorities into a scalable roadmap of AI, agentic AI, and automation capabilities across business domains. Establish AI-driven product management frameworks including experimentation, rapid prototyping, data-informed decision making, AI-assisted roadmap planning, and continuous product optimization. Strong understanding of AI/ML ecosystems, generative AI, large language models, enterprise AI platforms, intelligent agents, and copilots. Experience with AI product lifecycle management, experimentation methodologies, and agile delivery models. Familiarity with enterprise data ecosystems, APIs, cloud platforms, analytics, and AI infrastructure. Understanding of responsible AI frameworks, governance principles, security, and compliance considerations.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven decision-making mindset.

We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Sales

Reckitt is looking for a skilled business analyst to join its Walmart team. This role is based in Bentonville, AR and has a hybrid work structure (+3 days/week in office to be decided upon with your manager) in a new, state-of-the-art office building.

Our Sales teams help to deliver Reckitt's purpose by building shared success with our customers, making access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment possible in-stores and online. 

The Business Analyst supports Reckitt's Walmart business by analyzing sales performance, promotions, assortment, pricing, and shopper trends to generate actionable insights. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Category, and Trade teams, this role helps drive growth, optimize execution, and support strategic decision-making across Walmart's in-store and online channels.

About The Role

Within Sales, we're focused on achieving outperformance across all our channels, operating in highly competitive categories. This focus results in a dynamic, fast paced environment where cross functional teams are encouraged to collaborate to achieve success. 

 

We have around 10,000 salespeople across the world, within market roles and ranging in areas like Field Sales, Key Accounts, Trade Marketing and Category Development.

Your responsibilities

Analyze and report sales, promotion, pricing, assortment, and placement performance across Walmart channels.Deliver actionable insights, maintain weekly business reporting, support forecasting and item setup, monitor digital content accuracy, identify deductions, manage data provider attribution, and support line reviews, category insights, and ad hoc business needs.Support sales in delivering and presenting insights to support line reviews and meetings, justifying business decisions. Key data types may include sales performance, market trends, consumer insights, inventory levels, and competitive analysis. Provide Ad Hoc assistance for KAM or team members whenever needed. May be required to utilize platforms like Scintilla Shopper Behavior, Scintilla Report Builder, Nielsen, Numerator, and PowerBI.Monitor Walmart.com content quality to ensure product accuracy, visibility, and error-free listings through Supplier One. 

The experience we're looking for

The skills for success

Key Account Management, Account Management, Ecommerce, Analysing sales and Ecommerce data, Consumer Insights; Shopper Insights; Customer Insights; Category Analysis, Collaboration and partnership skills; Influencing, Consultative Selling, Perform product planning, Business accumen; financial accumen, commercial accumen, Sales negotiation, Strategy Execution, Operational Excellence.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. Job Description

Are you an upcoming 2027 graduate who wants to work on a large scale to drive significant business impact? Procter & Gamble is looking for people interested in different types of engineering: software, platform, or network to apply innovative technologies to business problems that require out of the box thinking. The work you will be doing could be anything from building data pipelines to feed Machine Learning models on petabytes of data that serve predictions globally, to building out consumer facing Internet of Things (IoT) Platforms, to building serverless applications to drive business needs from HR to Information Security. Regardless of the team, as a P&G IT Engineer you are someone who solves business problems using technology. 

You are primarily a problem solver, comfortable writing code, debugging, and working hands-on. You can independently identify problems and their solutions. You are interested in continuously learning and developing your own breadth and depth of technical knowledge and its application. You have a solid foundation in Computer Science fundamentals. You take pride in the quality of solutions that you build and strive to make everything automated, testable, and scalable. You work collaboratively with others on your team and across different teams, are interested learning from others, and have a desire to share your knowledge with the broader internal engineering community. 

 

Example Responsibilities by Role Type:  

Software Engineering: Translate system requirements and user stories into scalable, maintainable application designs and high-quality code. Develop, test, and validate solutions to ensure functionality, reliability, and performance. Implement and support code throughout the software development lifecycle, leveraging CI/CD tools for efficient integration and deployment. Serve as an escalation point for critical network issues and play a key role in strategic projects, collaborating with operations teams and IT stakeholders to ensure reliable service and successful outcomes.Platform Engineering: Manage cloud platforms using configuration management to deliver secure, scalable, and automated solutions. Drive platform standards, resolve cloud and security incidents, and continuously improve engineering maturity across cloud services. Lead innovation through proof-of-concept initiatives, evaluate third-party cloud solutions, collaborate with service providers and product teams, and contribute to the Cloud Community of Practice to promote knowledge sharing, reusable code, and consistent standards across P&G.

A history of solving hard problems with creative solutions.  Experience with Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.   Understand CI/CD and DevSecOps philosophies.

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Master Data Analyst (12-month contract) to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food maker with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. Founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry across three major geographic regions.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here's The Scoop – Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Master Data Analyst (12-month contract) to join our Project Management Office (PMO).

In a fast-paced Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) environment, clean, consistent, and structured data is the foundation of efficient operations, accurate reporting, and successful new product launches.

Reporting directly to the PMO Director and working in close partnership with the Master Data Manager, this "hands-on" role will be responsible for the accuracy, quality, and lifecycle management of our critical business data domains.

You will act as the bridge between strategic project milestones (such as New Product Introductions) and the technical execution of Master Data Management (MDM), ensuring that Champion operates with one source of truth.

The Master Data Analyst (12-month contract) works out of our Corporate office in Louisville (CO), Nashville (TN) or Edmonton (AB) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

What a typical day looks like:

Master Data Maintenance & Quality Assurance 

Data Creation & Management: Execute the hands-on creation, maintenance, and modification of master data records across key domains, with a primary focus on the Product domain (product catalogs, packaging specs, formulation recipes, and hierarchies) as well as Customer, Supplier/Vendor, and Location domains.Data Discrepancy Resolution: Actively troubleshoot data entry errors and resolve naming inconsistencies (e.g., standardizing brand nomenclature like "Six Fish" vs. "6 Fish", "Recipe" vs. "RCP") to prevent downstream operational issues.Auditing & Cleansing: Perform regular data audits and execute cleansing procedures for obsolete, duplicate, or unused data to maintain a clean database and prevent team members from losing valuable time "hunting" for the right information.Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Ensure all data-entry activities strictly adhere to established data standards, workflows, controls, and policies defined by the Master Data Manager and Finance Governance.

 PMO Integration & Cross-Functional Alignment

Project Support & NPI Readiness: Collaborate with PMO Project Managers to track and coordinate master data readiness for New Product Introductions (NPI), stage-gate processes, and supply chain transitions.Workflow Coordination: Facilitate cross-functional data collection workflows. Partner closely with Business Data Stewards in Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure correct data inputs are gathered and uploaded in alignment with project timelines.System Integration Support: Assist the Master Data Manager and IT teams in gathering requirements, defining data structures, and ensuring smooth, automated master data integration across multiple enterprise systems (ERP, PLM, MDM tools).Progress Reporting: Prepare regular status reports and dashboards regarding data readiness, quality metrics, and bottleneck areas to the PMO and Master Data Manager.

Support & Enablement

End-User Training: Assist in developing training materials and provide ongoing support to business users and Data Stewards on data management workflows and standard practices.Continuous Improvement: Identify and recommend areas for data quality improvements, process simplification, and automation opportunities within the PMO and broader business units

What are we looking for?

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Project Management, or a related field.Experience: 2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Master Data Specialist, or Product Information Analyst, ideally within a CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) or manufacturing company.Domain Knowledge: Foundational understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts (data governance, stewards, owners, schemas, and hierarchies).

Skills & Attributes:

Meticulous Attention to Detail: A natural instinct to spot and fix data discrepancies.Collaboration & Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills to follow up with team members across different departments and hold others accountable for data deadlines.Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive attitude that thrives on resolving "rabbit holes" of data confusion and building efficient, standardized processes.Project Management Orientation: Ability to manage multiple priorities and align data-related tasks with strict project timelines.

Systems & Tools

Strong proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, JD Edwards) and PLM/MDM software. Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data cleaning functions).Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) or PMO collaboration software is a plus

What can you expect from Champion?

Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.

Other Perks: Free Bag of Premium Pet Food each month, Free Parking and more!

Position Summary

The Specialist, Category Strategy supports the development and execution of customer-centric category growth strategies for Nutrition as well as supporting planogram development, shelf optimization, reporting, and execution support. This role combines category analytics, shopper and retailer insights, assortment and layout strategy, and space planning expertise to create actionable recommendations that improve product visibility, shopper experience, and category performance. Working closely with Category Managers, Category Leadership Managers, Sales, Space Planning, and cross-functional partners, this role translates data and insights into compelling category stories, scalable tools, and effective shelf solutions that can be executed with speed, quality, and consistency across customers and divisions.

Key Responsibilities

Category Strategy & Analytics

Support Category Managers and Category Leadership Managers in developing customer-specific category growth strategies, business reviews, and customer-facing recommendations.Analyze syndicated, customer, shopper, retailer, marketplace, and internal performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, whitespace, and growth drivers.Develop category stories and recommendations related to assortment, pricing, promotion, merchandising, innovation, renovation, new item support, and display considerations.Conduct performance analyses, including pre- and post-evaluation of category initiatives, merchandising programs, planogram actions, assortment changes, and shelving recommendations.Translate analysis into clear, actionable insights and visual storytelling for internal planning, customer meetings, and business decision support.

Planogram Development, Validation & Execution

Support building, maintain, validate, revise, and execute multiple versions of planograms based on assortment, clustering alternatives, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, retailer requirements, and customer objectives.Review planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture realities, execution readiness, and quality requirements.Provide support for display merchandising, modular events, shelf layouts, product placement, and retail partner implementation where applicable.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy

Support assortment and layout strategy development by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf recommendations.Contribute to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternative assessments, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes.Analyze shelf performance and recommend space allocation improvements that maximize category growth, product visibility, and shopper experience.Monitor and measure shelf strategy effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

Use planogram, space management, category, and reporting tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, and consistency in planogram development and maintenance.Help develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources.Identify opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, analytics, and execution workflows.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

Partner with Category Management, Category Leadership, Sales, Space Planning, Customer Teams, Field Sales, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure recommendations translate into executable shelf solutions.Share reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams to improve quality, speed, and alignment.Bring forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, scalable process improvements, and new ways of working that support total Nestlé growth.Build trusted relationships with internal and external partners while demonstrating curiosity, initiative, tenacity, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Consumer Insights, Retail Management, Space Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.2+ years of experience in Sales, Category Management, Shopper Insights, Analytics, Space Management, or a related manufacturer/retailer role; CPG and/or food industry experience preferred.Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint; ability to synthesize data and translate analytics into business recommendations, execution plans, and customer-facing stories.Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management or similar planogram/space planning tools preferred.Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data sources such as Circana, NielsenIQ, Numerator, retailer data, and internal reporting to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.Experience using SQL, Python, automation, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, reporting, or planogram workflows is a plus.

Core Capabilities

Strong analytical, storytelling, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations.Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment.Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, problem-solving, and willingness to challenge current ways of working while helping build future-state capabilities.Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, Space Planning, customer teams, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel

Approximately 15–20% travel may be required for national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

rows.title: Head of Space Optimisation
rows.descriptionText:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Property Operations at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way

What You’ll Do

The Head of Space Optimisation is accountable for defining and delivering a best-in-class, end-to-end space strategy that positions space as a critical commercial lever for driving sales, margin and store productivity across the estate. This role brings together space optimisation across all stores (LFL and New), refits, CAD, and data and modelling into a single, integrated team, ensuring a consistent and commercially optimised approach to how space is designed, allocated and executed.

Operating at a strategic and enterprise-wide level, the role leads the development of data-led capabilities, including a centralised Space Optimisation Model, to enable smarter, more scalable decision-making across Merchandising, Retail and Store Development. The role is responsible for translating Primark's product and space strategy into executable plans across all stores, ensuring space allocation supports customer needs, category performance and long-term commercial objectives.

The role will establish and embed best-in-class space optimisation processes, creating a consistent approach to optimising and managing space across the estate. A key focus is maximising return on investment across all capital projects relating to space optimisation.

Through strong cross-functional leadership and a focus on performance, the role ensures that space is fully optimised across the store lifecycle, from initial feasibility and design through to in-store execution and ongoing continuous improvement, delivering measurable commercial impact and supporting long-term business growth.

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:

Define and deliver the Space Optimisation strategy, positioning space as a key driver of sales, margin, store productivity and overall business performance.Act as a key strategic partner to senior stakeholders across Retail, Merchandising, Buying and Property, influencing decisions, building commitment to shared outcomes and driving business-wide change to maximise the commercial performance of space.Own the end-to-end space optimisation framework and governance, ensuring robust processes, clear decision-making and consistently high-quality delivery across all space activity.Lead space optimisation across new stores and refits, covering shopfloor and back-of-house layouts, adjacencies and space allocation to maximise conversion, customer flow, productivity and commercial performance.Lead the development and adoption of a centralised Space Optimisation Model, supporting data-driven decision-making across Merchandising, Grading, Option Management, Linear Planning and Retail performance.Oversee CAD and linear planning across the estate, improving planning accuracy, product grading integrity and execution while delivering a scalable approach at department and sub-department level.Own space data, reporting, modelling and performance metrics, using advanced analytics and insight to identify opportunities, measure outcomes and continuously improve space productivity.Lead and develop a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team, creating clear accountability, strong collaboration and an inclusive culture while coaching and empowering individuals to take ownership of their development and deliver commercial impact.

What You’ll Bring

We want every person in our organisation to feel like they’re making a key contribution. Here are some of the experiences and skills you’ll need for the role:

Senior leadership experience (10+ years) in retail space optimisation, ideally within a global, multi-market environment.Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to use space as a strategic lever to drive sales, margin, conversion and store productivity.Highly data-driven and analytical, with proven experience translating complex data and insights into clear commercial decisions and actions.Strong strategic and operational capability, able to set long-term direction while maintaining focus on execution, commercial discipline and continuous improvement.Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience partnering at executive level and working effectively across internal teams, consultants, contractors and suppliers.Strong technical expertise in space optimisation and planning, including proficiency in relevant tools such as AutoCAD and the ability to drive innovation in systems, tools and ways of working.Proven experience building and leading high-performing teams, creating clear accountability through target setting, performance management, engagement and development.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle:

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

Primark was founded on a mission that everyone deserves to look and feel good – without paying more. We stand for great value without compromise, offering affordable fashion and everyday essentials that are made to last. Founded in Ireland in 1969, Primark is now an international fashion retailer with 500 stores across 19 countries in Europe, the US and the Middle East, employing more than 80,000 colleagues. Millions of shopper’s trust Primark every week for everything from everyday essentials like t-shirts and socks, to the latest fashion trends – all at unbeatable prices.

Primark is built on a belief and passion for physical stores – helping to bring high streets and retail centres to life and creating joyful, social experiences. The company is focused on driving positive change by giving clothing a longer life, protecting life on the planet and supporting the livelihoods of the people who make Primark clothes.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

rows.descriptionText:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

We’re seeking a strategic and experienced leader to drive EA’s global tax controversy and transfer pricing strategy. As our Director, Tax Controversy, you will own the company’s U.S. federal audit and controversy efforts (with opportunity to expand to controversy work outside the US), lead Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) strategy and negotiations, and build trusted, long-term relationships with tax authorities.

You will be in a highly visible role requiring deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and the ability to influence outcomes in complex, high-stakes situations relating to U.S. international and domestic taxation and transfer pricing, with proven success managing IRS tax controversies in a fast-paced, digital business environment.

You will bring a proven track record of successfully leading tax audits and disputes, shaping controversy strategy and enabling the team to operate it, and partnering across the business to align tax positions with EA’s global operating model. This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Transfer Pricing & Controversy. You will work a hybrid role, requiring three days per week in an EA office

Key Responsibilities

Tax Controversy & Audit Management

 In collaboration with the Senior Director, Transfer Pricing & Tax Controversy, lead EA’s U.S. federal tax audits, controversy strategy, manage IRS examinations and assist with negotiation and settlements. Develop and execute audit defense strategies supported by robust technical documentation and analytics. Ability to advise on the interpretation of IRS Code and Regulations by the IRS Exam Team and Counsel assigned to EA’s case. Prepare strong, technically supported responses to audit queries and documentation requests. Manage and assist with negotiating Advance Pricing Agreements (APAs) and maintain documentation for U.S. uncertain tax positions (FIN 48). Provide strategic input on cross-border transactions, IP integration, entity rationalization, and business expansions. Partner with Legal, Finance, and Treasury to assist in implementing tax-efficient global structures while ensuring compliance. Represent EA in discussions with tax authorities, demonstrating professionalism, transparency, and strategic negotiation skills. Advise senior leadership on controversy risk, audit developments, and resolution strategies, including financial statement implications (e.g., FIN 48)

Cross-Functional Leadership

 Collaborate effectively across the organization — including Finance, Legal, Accounting, People Experience, and business units — to ensure tax alignment with operational goals. Communicate complex tax matters clearly to non-tax stakeholders, executives, and the Tax Leadership Team. Mentor and develop team members globally, fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and technical excellence. Contribute to EA’s broader tax strategy through proactive engagement with policy, industry trends, and technology transformation. Support process and system improvements leveraging automation and data analytics and participate in strategic initiatives related to EA’s ongoing digital and operational transformation.

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA, JD, or LLM in Taxation strongly preferred. 10+ years of tax consulting, compliance, and reporting experience in Big 4 and/or U.S. multinational corporate tax department, with focus on U.S. and domestic international tax (experience with R&D credit helpful). Proven success leading IRS tax audits and controversies (controversy experience outside the U.S. also helpful). In-depth knowledge of U.S. international tax provisions (GILTI/NCTI, FDII/FDDEI, BEAT, FTC) and OECD developments (BEPS, Pillar Two) would be beneficial. Experience with digital economy taxation, IP structuring, and transfer pricing. Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership and tax authorities. Experience managing teams and collaborating across global, matrixed organizations. Self motivated, accountable, and collaborative; able to manage multiple priorities and complex projects simultaneously while working effectively as part of high-performing team.

We are looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join our Worlds research pillar and help redefine game world authoring technologies. This is an applied research role: you will bring your boldest ideas to life inside the game engine, crafting high-impact prototypes and demos that turn complex science into practical creative superpowers.

rows.title: Senior Manager, Culture Marketing Seeding
rows.descriptionText:
Position Overview

At adidas, we never launch a product unless we consider it perfect.

Our brand teams bring together creativity, cultural insight, product expertise, and operational excellence to create meaningful connections with consumers. Through thoughtful product seeding, we put the right product in the hands of influential talent, partners, and cultural voices who help shape how adidas shows up in sport, fashion, and culture.

As Senior Manager, Culture Marketing Operations, you will lead the development and execution of Culture Marketing seeding strategy in partnership with the Director of Culture Marketing Seeding. You will own product planning, inventory governance, operational frameworks, and performance measurement to maximize product investments and enable scalable support of adidas' global talent, partner, and influencer networks.

Working across Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, Market teams, agencies, and vendors, you will drive alignment from seasonal planning through execution. This role is strategically important to strengthening operational discipline, improving visibility into seeding performance, and ensuring resources are deployed against the brand's most important cultural opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

 Seeding Strategy: Lead the development and execution of Culture Marketing seeding strategy aligned with brand priorities, cultural relevance, and consumer impact. Allocation Governance: Establish seeding frameworks, allocation principles, and prioritization models that maximize product investment and support strategic talent and partner relationships. Product Planning: Own end-to-end forecasting, allocation, inventory management, and product lifecycle oversight across Culture Marketing seeding initiatives. Inventory Management: Drive accurate inventory tracking, reconciliation, reporting, and governance while continuously improving seeding processes and tools. Seasonal Planning: Partner with Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, and Market teams to develop seasonal seeding and gifting plans aligned with product and campaign timelines. Cross-Functional Execution: Lead planning and delivery of key seeding initiatives, aligning stakeholders, resources, timelines, and business objectives. Agency and Vendor Management: Manage external agency and vendor partners against established scope, budget, service levels, and performance expectations. Analytics and Reporting: Develop performance measurement and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into inventory health, seeding impact, operational efficiency, and business opportunities. Financial Management: Manage seeding budgets, forecasting, and spend tracking while maintaining financial discipline, compliance, and responsible stewardship of company resources. Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the Seeding team through clear objectives, accountability, collaboration, and capability building that supports evolving business needs.

Required Qualifications

 Strong knowledge of the sports industry with a demonstrated passion for fashion, streetwear, and relevant cultural trends. Strong strategic planning and prioritization skills with the ability to balance long-term objectives and immediate business needs. Strong understanding of inventory management, product allocation, and operational planning. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across a complex matrix organization. Data-driven approach to decision making with the ability to translate insights into clear business actions. Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, spend management, and vendor oversight. Strong attention to detail with a results-focused approach to execution. Ability to prioritize and oversee multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated leadership capabilities with the ability to establish accountability, foster collaboration, and develop team capabilities.

Preferred Experience

 Experience supporting product seeding, gifting, influencer, talent, or Culture Marketing programs within a global consumer brand environment. Experience partnering across Brand, Communications, Product Marketing, Business Units, and regional or Market organizations. Experience developing reporting, analytics, or performance measurement frameworks for product investment and operational programs.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position follows the adidas Hybrid work policy, requiring in-office attendance Monday through Thursday with flexibility to work remotely on Friday. In-office attendance is required on Fridays when the work requires a high degree of collaboration or an in-person presentation. The working location for this position is Los Angeles, California. The role operates in a highly collaborative, cross-functional, and global environment. Travel expectations are based on business needs.

REPORTING STRUCTURE

This role works in close partnership with the Director of Culture Marketing Seeding and leads, coaches, and develops the Seeding team. The position has significant cross-functional exposure across Global Brands, Communications, Business Units, Product Marketing, Market teams, agencies, and vendor partners.

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer-packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Title Director (Level 17)

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

Location 

This is a hybrid position located in Columbus, OH. You will be required to work onsite 2-3 days a week in our Columbus, OH office.

What will you be doing? 

Circana seeks a passionate consultant and client advocate with strong analytic skills to advance solutions and insights that best build the client strategic vision. Collaborate with our clients and internal teams to maximize and apply insights gleaned from Circana data including store data analysis, household purchase behavior analysis, surveys, audits, data modeling, in-market testing, and other custom projects. Be an advocate for the client and create/close new opportunities with them.

Job Responsibilities

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Manage the Sales Cycle: Lead end-to-end sales processes including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, negotiation, and closing. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Achieve Revenue Targets: Meet or exceed individual and team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

7+ years of experience with syndicated data, analytics, category management, or related fieldsMarketing and/or sales with a premier Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) company or other companiesExperience with IRI/Circana data solutions is preferred; experience with syndicated datasets is requiredExperience in the Health Care space ideally in the Nutrition segmentDemonstrated expertise in translating data and analysis into relevant implicationsExperience with syndicated dataStrong project management and process skillsProven ability to consult with clients to influence thinking

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $102K to $105K.

This job is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

rows.title: Manager, Internal Communications
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

Do the most meaningful work of your career, all while enjoying our delicious pizza, too! At Domino's, we believe in the Power of Possible. Our curiosity drives us to connect the dots and uncover opportunities that can move us forward, empowering us to aim high and pursue bold, innovative outcomes.

Domino's global communications and community team brings our Hungry for MORE strategy to life by sharing the stories of our people, franchisees, and brand with audiences around the world. The team connects the people behind our brand to the mission, values, and operational updates that drive success across corporate offices, supply chain hubs, and restaurants. You will work with professionals whose backgrounds include communications strategy, public relations, graphic design, community, and event production.

As Manager, Internal Communications, you will design and execute internal communication strategy across restaurant, supply chain, and franchisee audiences. You will connect corporate leadership with frontline audiences and manage a complex ecosystem of digital channels to deliver clear, timely, actionable messages. This dynamic role requires project management, cross-functional partnership, strategic communications, and analytics experience.

What You'll Do

Design and execute a comprehensive internal communications strategy, and lead, coach, and develop internal communication specialists who create communication plans and campaigns for internal audiences and initiatives. Lead and develop talent on the direct team and across the broader organization. Manage and optimize the internal digital channel ecosystem, including the intranet, team member app, corporate email, push notifications, SMS text, and digital signage. Partner with franchisees to deliver clear, actionable, and timely business updates that support operational success and strengthen brand alignment. Translate supply chain and operational information, including logistics updates, inventory changes, and distribution milestones, into simple, scannable, mobile-first communications for frontline team members. Draft rapid, accurate emergency communications for team members and franchisees, and apply sound visual judgment to content for digital signage and the employee app. Measure channel engagement, test message resonance, identify opportunities to communicate global messages, and use data to improve readership, content strategy, and operational compliance. 

Qualifications

Minimum of 5 years of experience managing internal, corporate, or franchisee communications. Proven success managing and scaling modern internal communication tools and leading multichannel project plans, such as employee apps, SMS platforms, push notifications, and digital signage. Exceptional ability to tailor tone, format, and complexity for different audiences, from executive leadership to frontline restaurant workers. Track record of translating complex operational logistics into simple, scannable, and actionable copy. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and knowledge of content management systems. Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to travel occasionally, estimated at less than 5%. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the retail, hospitality, or restaurant industries. Two years of experience managing direct or indirect team members. 

What You'll Bring

In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:

Be Curious

Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively. Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills. 

Connect the Dots

Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions. Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions. 

Aim High

Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results. Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes. 

Shift Fast

Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results. Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks. 

Deliver More

Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results. Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business. 

Leadership Expectations

Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino's Ways of Working. Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others. Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance. Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals. 

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
