Description & Requirements

Our Team 

Bloomberg's Portfolio & Risk Analytics business delivers some of the industry's most sophisticated risk management, valuation, portfolio construction, and investment analytics solutions to leading asset managers, pension funds, insurers, hedge funds, and sovereign institutions around the world.

This is powered by Bloomberg's Multi-Asset Class Model (MAC3), a proprietary factor-based risk model designed to help institutional investors understand, measure, and manage portfolio risk across global asset classes. The model provides forward-looking risk estimates and decomposes portfolio risk into systematic market factors and asset-specific (idiosyncratic) risk, providing a comprehensive view of the drivers of portfolio volatility and diversification. MAC3 is also utilized to support portfolio construction and optimization. Investors can use the model to evaluate proposed trades, manage factor exposures, assess diversification, incorporate investment constraints, and understand how changes in portfolio composition may affect overall risk.

Unlike models built for a single asset class, MAC3 is designed to deliver a consistent risk framework across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities, derivatives, and alternatives, enabling investors to evaluate risk and construct portfolios holistically across diversified investment strategies.

What's the Role? 

We are seeking a highly collaborative, technically sophisticated, and commercially driven Risk Model Sales Specialist to drive the growth of Bloomberg's MAC3 factor risk model datasets across North America. This is a new-business sales role with accountability for developing a qualified pipeline, acquiring new institutional clients, expanding strategic relationships, and delivering against annual revenue goals.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analytics, portfolio construction, and enterprise technology. You will partner with some of the world's largest and most sophisticated investment firms.

Acting as a trusted advisor throughout the sales lifecycle, you will lead technical and commercial engagements, uncover client requirements, understand portfolio risk, construction, and optimization workflows, and demonstrate how Bloomberg's MAC3 risk model can address complex investment and enterprise data needs.

You will manage opportunities from initial discovery and qualification through technical evaluation, proposal, negotiation, and close. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Account Management, Legal, and Implementation teams globally, serving as both a market-facing sales specialist and a strategic voice for our clients. Your insights will directly influence product development and help shape the future direction of Bloomberg's risk solutions.

We'll Trust You To

 Drive New Business Growth - Develop and execute territory and account strategies to originate new opportunities, acquire new institutional clients, expand strategic relationships, and deliver against quarterly and annual revenue goals across North America. Build and Manage a Qualified Pipeline - Identify, prospect, qualify, and prioritize opportunities across asset managers, asset owners, hedge funds, insurers, and sovereign institutions. Maintain disciplined opportunity management, activity tracking, and forecast accuracy. Own Complex Sales Cycles - Lead opportunities from initial discovery and qualification through business-case development, RFP and RFI responses, proposals, pricing, procurement, contract negotiation, and commercial close. Lead Strategic Client Engagements - Develop relationships with CROs, senior risk managers, quantitative teams, portfolio managers, portfolio construction and optimization teams, model validation groups, data and technology teams, and operational stakeholders across leading buy-side institutions. Translate Investment Workflows into Solutions - Understand how clients use factor risk models for risk estimation, portfolio construction and optimization, factor exposure management, scenario analysis, model validation, and investment oversight. Translate these requirements into differentiated MAC3 data and workflow solutions. Lead Technical Evaluations - Coordinate tailored demonstrations, methodology discussions, model comparisons, data evaluations, trials, and proofs of concept in partnership with Product, Research, Engineering, and other technical specialists. Influence Product Strategy - Act as a key conduit between clients and Bloomberg’s Product, Engineering, and Research teams by communicating market trends, competitive intelligence, and structured client feedback that helps shape future product development. Represent Bloomberg’s Risk Business - Build Bloomberg’s presence in the institutional risk and quantitative investment community through industry events, client forums, and other market-facing engagements.

You'll Need To Have 

 5+ years of experience selling institutional investment technology, risk analytics, portfolio management, factor model data, or other quantitative solutions. A demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing complex enterprise opportunities. Strong understanding of factor risk models and their application to risk estimation, portfolio construction, optimization, factor exposure management, and institutional investment decision-making. Demonstrated success selling into institutional asset managers, asset owners, hedge funds, insurers, or sovereign wealth funds. Proven ability to originate new opportunities while expanding strategic client relationships. Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple technical, investment, commercial, procurement, and legal stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting model evaluations, trials, proofs of concept, RFPs, proposals, and commercial negotiations. The ability to translate quantitative and technical concepts into clear business value for audiences ranging from quantitative specialists and model validation teams to CIOs, CROs, and technology executives. Familiarity with enterprise data-delivery and integration considerations associated with quantitative datasets, including file-based delivery, APIs, cloud platforms, or internal analytical systems. Excellent collaboration, communication, presentation, and organizational skills, with the ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional teams. Willingness to travel throughout the region to meet clients and prospects.

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is currently recruiting for a Senior Data & Applied AI Engineer located in North America or LATAM.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. For more than 130 years, we have worked to make a meaningful difference in the lives of people around the world through science, innovation, and technology. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas drive breakthrough solutions that improve human health.

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Data & Applied AI Engineer with deep expertise in Data and AI Engineering to design, build, and scale enterprise data products, AI solutions, and MLOps platforms. The role will lead the development of reliable data pipelines, reusable data products, AI-enabled services, and model operationalization capabilities. The engineer will also apply cloud-native, API, and full-stack development skills to integrate these capabilities into secure, scalable enterprise solutions.

The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with deep experience in modern data engineering and applied AI, complemented by practical expertise in MLOps, cloud-native architectures, APIs, and application development. This individual will establish engineering standards, mentor team members, and help translate emerging technologies, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, into governed, production-ready enterprise capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Azure Data Factory, and Azure cloud data services. Develop reusable, governed data products and analytical datasets that support enterprise reporting, advanced analytics, and AI use cases. Design and implement AI and Generative AI solutions, including retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, integration, and production operationalization. Build and operate MLOps capabilities that support model development, deployment, monitoring, lineage, governance, and lifecycle management. Define data architecture, data quality, metadata, observability, security, and performance standards for enterprise data and AI platforms. Develop cloud-native platform services, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven components, and enterprise integrations that expose data and AI capabilities. Build fit-for-purpose user experiences and full-stack applications using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and comparable technologies where required to operationalize data and AI solutions. Create reusable platform components, shared libraries, templates, CLI tools, and developer productivity solutions. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, DevOps automation, GitOps workflows, and infrastructure-as-code solutions. Implement secure authentication, authorization, RBAC, auditability, secrets management, and enterprise security controls. Implement observability across data pipelines, AI services, applications, and infrastructure, including logging, monitoring, tracing, data-quality monitoring, and performance management. Collaborate with data scientists, product teams, architects, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data and AI solutions. Lead proofs of concept, technical evaluations, and innovation initiatives focused on data, AI, and platform technologies. Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews to ensure quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and regulatory readiness. Troubleshoot complex distributed systems spanning data platforms, AI services, applications, infrastructure, and cloud services. Mentor engineers and establish data, AI, and software engineering standards while remaining hands-on in critical delivery activities. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field. 6+ years of engineering experience, including substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data, AI, analytical, or cloud platforms. Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, SQL, and distributed data-processing patterns. Hands-on experience with Databricks, Azure Data Factory, data lake or lakehouse architectures, and Azure cloud data services. Experience designing batch and streaming data pipelines, reusable data products, analytical data models, and data integration solutions. Strong understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, data contracts, schema evolution, performance optimization, observability, security, and governance. Experience developing or integrating applied AI and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-enabled applications. Experience operationalizing AI or ML workloads through automated deployment, monitoring, lifecycle management, and governance. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, automated testing, version control, APIs, algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, and architecture. Experience designing cloud-native services and deploying containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, preferably Azure Kubernetes Service. Experience with Azure cloud-native architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, authentication, authorization, and enterprise security controls. Practical experience developing APIs, backend services, and fit-for-purpose user interfaces using modern frameworks. Strong communication, technical leadership, stakeholder management, customer/vendor mangement, collaboration, mentoring, and problem-solving skills. Work with offshore teams and ensure the best practices are adopted during the delivery Experience with IT finance managing SOWs and resource planning Ability to travel up to 5%, including international travel. 

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Databricks and lakehouse architecture experience. Experience with streaming technologies and event-driven data processing. Knowledge of Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and LLM application development. Experience with MLflow or comparable tools for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management. Experience with ZenML or comparable ML platform orchestration frameworks. Experience implementing data and AI governance in regulated environments. Experience with GitOps deployment practices using ArgoCD or similar. Experience with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, and Azure Monitor. Experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, NestJS, Vite, TypeORM, Nx Monorepo, NGINX, ingress controllers, or comparable technologies. Familiarity with ERP/SAP platforms and enterprise integration patterns. Knowledge of IoT, edge computing, and industrial data solutions. 

What Makes This Role Exciting

Shape enterprise-scale Data and AI platforms that support healthcare innovation. 

Required Skills

Preferred Skills:

Advanced Analytics, Agility Jumps, Analytical Reasoning, Coaching, Critical Thinking, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data Privacy Standards, Data Quality, Data Science, Hybrid Clouds, Motivating People, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Technologically Savvy

This is an exciting opportunity to join Deloitte Operations for an engagement with one of our clients.

 The Role 

We are seeking an experienced VP-level Third-Party Risk specialist to support the review, redesign and implementation of key third-party risk management processes across a large, complex and highly regulated financial services organisation.

The role will focus on assessing current-state processes and designing enhanced future-state capabilities across key risk domains including supplier exit planning, single/sole source risk, exit testing, material subcontractor (nth-party) oversight and third-party assurance.

The successful candidate will be responsible for aligning processes to industry best practice, emerging regulatory expectations and strategic business objectives, before supporting pilot execution, implementation planning and enterprise-wide rollout.

Experience & Skills Required

This is an exciting opportunity to join Deloitte Operations for an engagement with one of our clients.

 The Role 

As a Partner Customer Success Manager, you are the named post-sales owner for a portfolio of high-value accounting firms — both a strategic advisor and a platform adoption expert. You help each firm grow its practice and get more value from QuickBooks: migrating client books onto the platform, driving adoption of the wider Intuit ecosystem, defending the relationship against competitors, and representing the firm’s interests inside Intuit. You manage a large named book through a mix of a regular personal cadence, signal-triggered 1:1 outreach, and digital / 1: many leverage, using data to focus your time where it moves the needle most.

If you are commercially minded, comfortable managing a large portfolio through smart prioritisation rather than blanket high-touch, and motivated by helping accounting partners succeed, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

 Portfolio & relationship management 

Â· Own a named book of high-value accountant firms as their primary post-sales contact and single point of accountability.

Â· Build trusted relationships with firm leadership and key stakeholders; run the scheduled value cadence and review firm health continuously.

Â· Identify at-risk firms early and drive proactive engagement and recovery plans.

Â· Help the accounting firm to grow their business using Quickbooks, by way of regular success planning.

 Onboarding & enablement 

Â· Deliver a personal welcome and a clean handoff from introduction so new firms reach first value quickly.

Â· Guide firms through ProAdvisor certification and ProPartner tier progression, and drive ongoing product education through webinars and content, stepping in 1:1 when a firm stalls.

 Growth & revenue influence 

Â· Help firms migrate more of their client books onto QuickBooks and attach the wider ecosystem (Payroll, Payments, Time, Bill Pay), move clients up tiers, and adopt the Intuit Accountant Suite (IAS).

Â· Aim pre-built expansion campaign kits at the right clients; partner with GTM / Sales on co-sell and warm handovers, pre- and post-sale.

 Retention & product outcomes 

Â· Monitor firm and portfolio health and respond quickly when a risk signal fires (usage drop, stalled setup, health decline, or a competitor-migration flag). Defending a firm means defending its entire client book.

Â· Run one scheduled annual value review per firm, supported by an automated mid-year value snapshot.

Â· Act as a point of escalation for high-priority issues, coordinating Support and internal teams to a timely resolution.

 Advocacy & voice of the partner 

Â· Be the firm’s named escalation route and carry recurring product pain points back into Intuit as roadmap insight.

Â· Cultivate advocacy — referrals, testimonials and community participation — and use the Partner Health Score, portfolio dashboards and triggered task list to prioritise across a large book and evidence your impact.

Experience & Skills Required

rows.title: Manager/Solution Architect
rows.descriptionText:
Deloitte's Industrial Data Operations (IDO) practice helps clients turn plant-floor data into a trusted, reusable enterprise asset that powers operational excellence, connected enterprises, and digital transformation. We bring together people, processes, and technology to connect industrial assets and systems, contextualize data across IT and OT environments, govern data quality and access, and deliver reliable information for analytics and decision-making. Our work enables capabilities such as production performance, factory synchronization, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility, digital twins, and AI-enabled manufacturing applications-creating the scalable data foundation organizations need to move beyond brittle point-to-point solutions and realize value from their digital investments.

Work you'll do

You will serve as the platform-agnostic industrial data architecture authority, leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams across operational technology (OT), edge, and enterprise environments. You will define the OT-up architecture, including Unified Namespace (UNS) design, ISA-95 asset modeling, contextualization strategy, and integration topology across historian systems, edge platforms, and enterprise systems. You will also act as the technical voice in vice president- and director-level client conversations, translating plant-floor realities into practical architecture decisions.

In this role, you will partner closely with delivery leadership, handing off the cloud data platform layer to the Delivery Manager while continuing to guide the industrial data architecture. On Cognite Data Fusion (CDF) engagements, you will work with the Cognite Platform Architect to align architecture decisions with platform capabilities. This role is designed for someone with a controls or automation background who has moved into data architecture, or an OT integration lead from a vendor or systems integrator environment. You should be comfortable walking a plant floor, reading a piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID), and translating between operations and IT, with deep familiarity in at least two of the following: ISA-95/ISA-88 standards, OPC UA/UNS, historian systems, or edge platforms.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

 Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The teamWe are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Required Qualifications:

8+ years of experience in controls/automation engineering, OT integration, or industrial data architecture, including 5+ years leading architecture work across OT, edge, and enterprise environments and experience with a vendor or systems integrator.5+ years defining OT-up architecture, including 2+ years designing UNS architecture and ISA-95 asset models from scratch.5+ years designing connections among historian systems, edge platforms, and enterprise systems within industrial data architectures.5+ years leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams for industrial data or OT integration programs.Ability to serve as the technical voice in vice president- and director-level client conversations.5+ years translating between operations/OT and IT/enterprise stakeholders.3+ years of firsthand plant-floor experience, including reading and working from P&IDs.5+ years of hands-on experience with two or more of the following: ISA-95/ISA-88, OPC UA/UNS, historian systems, or edge platforms.5+ years maintaining a platform-agnostic architecture perspective while aligning designs to implementation needs.3+ years coordinating architecture handoffs to cloud data platform delivery leaders.3+ years partnering with platform architects, including Cognite Platform Architects on Cognite Data Fusion engagements where applicable.Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, or at least 8 years of equivalent practical experience.Ability to travel an average of 50% of working time based on client and industry needs.Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Comfortable coordinating with platform solution architects or alliance teams for platform-specific design support.Strong client communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.Data integration patterns between OT source systems and cloud analytics platforms.Experience designing or overseeing lakehouse schemas, time-series data mapping, cloud landing zone architecture, and data pipeline patterns.Ability to review data engineering deliverables in enough technical depth to identify architectural issues, integration risks, and design gaps.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. rows.title: AI Security Engineer Manager
rows.descriptionText:
As a Manager in AI Security Engineering, you will play a critical role in securing the development and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions. You will operate hands-on across high-visibility initiatives, embedding security, trust, and resilience into AI systems while enabling rapid, responsible innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/10/2026.

Work you'll do

You will bring strong engineering depth and applied AI knowledge, combined with expertise in cybersecurity principles, to design and deliver secure, scalable solutions. This role requires a collaborative, execution-focused leader who can influence teams, mentor engineers, and ensure AI systems meet enterprise security, risk, and compliance expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Secure, Outcome-Driven Delivery

Design and deliver AI-enabled solutions that are secure by design, balancing business value with risk mitigation. Solve complex problems while ensuring protection of data, models, and systems.

Hands-On AI Security Engineering

Actively contribute to architecture, design, and development of AI/ML and GenAI systems with embedded security controls. Integrate security across the SSDLC, including code reviews, testing, and deployment. In this role you will be responsible for managing AI defensive technologies and the operations of those technologies which will evolve over time.

AI Risk Identification and Mitigation

Identify and address AI-specific vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and misuse. Implement practical safeguards to ensure system integrity and trustworthiness.

Technical Leadership and Advocacy

Serve as a trusted technical voice for secure AI engineering. Ensure solutions are feasible, secure, and aligned with business and customer objectives.

Engineering Excellence with Security Focus

Maintain high standards for code quality, scalability, and security. Contribute to secure coding practices, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.

Iterative and Responsible Innovation

Support rapid experimentation while applying appropriate security guardrails. Enable teams to innovate safely through controlled, risk-aware development practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with product, engineering, cybersecurity, and risk teams to embed AI security into solutions. Balance usability, performance, and security in decision-making.

Standards and Best Practices

Apply and help evolve standards for AI security, including data protection, access control, model validation, and monitoring within DevSecOps and MLOps pipelines.

Communication and Influence

Clearly articulate technical risks, trade-offs, and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Contribute to alignment and informed decision-making.

Impact

rows.title: Manager/Solution Architect
rows.descriptionText:
Deloitte's Industrial Data Operations (IDO) practice helps clients turn plant-floor data into a trusted, reusable enterprise asset that powers operational excellence, connected enterprises, and digital transformation. We bring together people, processes, and technology to connect industrial assets and systems, contextualize data across IT and OT environments, govern data quality and access, and deliver reliable information for analytics and decision-making. Our work enables capabilities such as production performance, factory synchronization, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility, digital twins, and AI-enabled manufacturing applications-creating the scalable data foundation organizations need to move beyond brittle point-to-point solutions and realize value from their digital investments.

Work you'll do

You will serve as the platform-agnostic industrial data architecture authority, leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams across operational technology (OT), edge, and enterprise environments. You will define the OT-up architecture, including Unified Namespace (UNS) design, ISA-95 asset modeling, contextualization strategy, and integration topology across historian systems, edge platforms, and enterprise systems. You will also act as the technical voice in vice president- and director-level client conversations, translating plant-floor realities into practical architecture decisions.

In this role, you will partner closely with delivery leadership, handing off the cloud data platform layer to the Delivery Manager while continuing to guide the industrial data architecture. On Cognite Data Fusion (CDF) engagements, you will work with the Cognite Platform Architect to align architecture decisions with platform capabilities. This role is designed for someone with a controls or automation background who has moved into data architecture, or an OT integration lead from a vendor or systems integrator environment. You should be comfortable walking a plant floor, reading a piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID), and translating between operations and IT, with deep familiarity in at least two of the following: ISA-95/ISA-88 standards, OPC UA/UNS, historian systems, or edge platforms.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

 Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The teamWe are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Required Qualifications:

8+ years of experience in controls/automation engineering, OT integration, or industrial data architecture, including 5+ years leading architecture work across OT, edge, and enterprise environments and experience with a vendor or systems integrator.5+ years defining OT-up architecture, including 2+ years designing UNS architecture and ISA-95 asset models from scratch.5+ years designing connections among historian systems, edge platforms, and enterprise systems within industrial data architectures.5+ years leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams for industrial data or OT integration programs.Ability to serve as the technical voice in vice president- and director-level client conversations.5+ years translating between operations/OT and IT/enterprise stakeholders.3+ years of firsthand plant-floor experience, including reading and working from P&IDs.5+ years of hands-on experience with two or more of the following: ISA-95/ISA-88, OPC UA/UNS, historian systems, or edge platforms.5+ years maintaining a platform-agnostic architecture perspective while aligning designs to implementation needs.3+ years coordinating architecture handoffs to cloud data platform delivery leaders.3+ years partnering with platform architects, including Cognite Platform Architects on Cognite Data Fusion engagements where applicable.Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, or at least 8 years of equivalent practical experience.Ability to travel an average of 50% of working time based on client and industry needs.Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Comfortable coordinating with platform solution architects or alliance teams for platform-specific design support.Strong client communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.Data integration patterns between OT source systems and cloud analytics platforms.Experience designing or overseeing lakehouse schemas, time-series data mapping, cloud landing zone architecture, and data pipeline patterns.Ability to review data engineering deliverables in enough technical depth to identify architectural issues, integration risks, and design gaps.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $155,600 to $306,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

rows.descriptionText:
Deloitte's Industrial Data Operations (IDO) practice helps clients turn plant-floor data into a trusted, reusable enterprise asset that powers operational excellence, connected enterprises, and digital transformation. We bring together people, processes, and technology to connect industrial assets and systems, contextualize data across IT and OT environments, govern data quality and access, and deliver reliable information for analytics and decision-making. Our work enables capabilities such as production performance, factory synchronization, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility, digital twins, and AI-enabled manufacturing applications-creating the scalable data foundation organizations need to move beyond brittle point-to-point solutions and realize value from their digital investments.

Work you'll do

You will serve as the platform-agnostic industrial data architecture authority, leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams across operational technology (OT), edge, and enterprise environments. You will define the OT-up architecture, including Unified Namespace (UNS) design, ISA-95 asset modeling, contextualization strategy, and integration topology across historian systems, edge platforms, and enterprise systems. You will also act as the technical voice in vice president- and director-level client conversations, translating plant-floor realities into practical architecture decisions.

In this role, you will partner closely with delivery leadership, handing off the cloud data platform layer to the Delivery Manager while continuing to guide the industrial data architecture. rows.descriptionText:
Deloitte's Industrial Data Operations (IDO) practice helps clients turn plant-floor data into a trusted, reusable enterprise asset that powers operational excellence, connected enterprises, and digital transformation. We bring together people, processes, and technology to connect industrial assets and systems, contextualize data across IT and OT environments, govern data quality and access, and deliver reliable information for analytics and decision-making. Our work enables capabilities such as production performance, factory synchronization, predictive maintenance, supply chain visibility, digital twins, and AI-enabled manufacturing applications-creating the scalable data foundation organizations need to move beyond brittle point-to-point solutions and realize value from their digital investments.

You will serve as the platform-agnostic industrial data architecture authority, leading foundation advisory and implementation workstreams across operational technology (OT), edge, and enterprise environments. rows.title: Accelerate Graduate Programme - Enterprise Data & Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Capgemini Invent, Enterprise Data & Analytics, Graduate Programme (Associate Consultant)

Location & Start Months:

February: London

April: Glasgow

June: London

Eligibility

To be eligible for this programme, you must have obtained, or be studying towards, a minimum 2:2 degree. If you are currently studying, you must have completed your degree prior to proposed start date. We recognise that mitigating circumstances can have an impact on academic performance. If you have experienced any circumstances that you would like us to take into consideration, please provide details in your application.

About The Role You Are Considering

The Enterprise Data Analytics (EDA) pathway of the Accelerate Programme is designed for talented graduates who are passionate about data and AI. In EDA, we help clients unlock value from their data by combining data strategy, analytics, data science and AI innovation. Through our Accelerate Programme, you will develop a strong foundation in consulting while gaining hands on experience across a broad range of data and AI disciplines.

The Accelerate Programme

The Accelerate Programme is Capgemini Invent UK's award winning graduate development programme. Over approximately 19 to 21 months, you'll progress from Associate Consultant to Consultant through a blend of structured learning, coaching, mentoring and hands on client experience. Following an initial three week induction and a twelve week consulting training programme delivered by the Institute, you'll move into your chosen pathway, applying your skills on live client projects while benefiting from ongoing development, regular feedback and a strong graduate community. Travel to client sites may be required, and candidates should live within reasonable commuting distance of their chosen office location.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business. It will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home. Please note that you will be unable to work from home 100 percent of the time.

Your Role

As an Associate Consultant, you will develop the skills and experience needed to become a well rounded consultant, helping clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes. From day one, you will gain hands on experience on client projects, take early responsibility, and contribute to transformation programmes that drive real business value.

Alongside Your Project Work, You Will Benefit From a Structured Learning And Development Programme Through The Enterprise Data Analytics Academy, Designed To Accelerate Both Your Professional And Technical Growth. You Will Have The Opportunity To

Build core consulting skills in areas such as business analysis, stakeholder management, agile delivery, design thinking, storytelling, and communicationSupport clients in solving complex business, data, analytics, and AI challenges. Develop expertise in modern technologies, including AI, data visualisation, cloud platforms, automation tools, and programming languages such as Python and SQLApply your skills on live client engagements, delivering innovative solutions and tangible business outcomes. Contribute to large scale transformation programmes, working collaboratively across teams and stakeholdersAchieve industry recognised certifications and access continuous learning opportunities tailored to your interests and career goalsCollaborate with specialist communities, contribute to thought leadership and knowledge sharing initiatives, and participate in innovation challenges and hackathons.

At Capgemini, building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment for everyone.

Your Skills And Experience

We are particularly interested to learn if you have experience or are interested in working in the industries we operate in and are keen to start a career in an environment where you can drive change.

Ideally, You Will Have

A strong interest in data, analytics, AI, and technology driven problem solvingExperience with, or an interest in, tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs)Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret business challenges and identify insights from dataExcellent communication and teamwork skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non technical audiencesThe ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and adapt in a fast paced environment. A passion for continuous learning and personal development

An interest in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

Data analysis and insight generationData and AI strategy, governance, and architectureData science, AI, and innovationData platforms, engineering, and AI deploymentOperational analytics and data driven decision making

At Capgemini Invent, we take a holistic approach to recruitment. While academic achievement is considered, we equally value potential, curiosity and mindset, which will be assessed throughout the recruitment process.

What You'll Love About Working Here

Join a global community of innovators, technologists and consultants who are helping clients transform their businesses through technology. You'll gain hands on experience, continuous learning opportunities and the support to develop your career while contributing to meaningful work that creates lasting impact for clients, communities and society.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government's Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who

Declare they have a disabilityMeet the minimum essential criteria for the role

Please opt in during the application process.

Need to Know

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back three continuous years, and an unspent criminal record check (known as a Disclosure and Barring Service check). You will also need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard Checks. There are other criteria and checks required for BPSS and, throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility including, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients' businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you'll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what's possible. It's why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world's leading businesses, and it's how you'll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to do better, you'll build the skills you want. You'll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end to end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

rows.title: Enterprise Architect
rows.descriptionText:
Who You’ll Work WithSlalom is seeking an Enterprise Architect who can bring the art of the possible to life across large, complex client programs. This person combines broad technology depth, strong business judgment, and a practical delivery mindset to help clients turn ambitious outcomes into coherent, executable solutions. 
The Enterprise Architect will work across a portfolio of Salesforce, integration, cloud, data, and enterprise applications—not just a single platform—to define a clear technical direction and help teams deliver it. They will be equally credible with executives, product and business leaders, architects, and delivery teams. This is a hands-on consulting role: the architect organizes the right people, resolves difficult tradeoffs, advances sales and delivery, and produces tangible work products that move a program forward. 
In addition to expanding and developing Slalom's Enterprise Architecture capability, this role owns technical visions, target-state architectures, and roadmaps for strategic programs and pursuits. Architecture governance is used as a practical means to accelerate sound decisions and delivery—not as a detached governance function.  What You’ll DoPartner with client executives, business leaders, and delivery teams to understand desired outcomes, business processes, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, constraints, and measures of success. Translate those needs into practical, enterprise-level solution strategies and target-state architectures spanning business, application, integration, data, technology, security, and operating-model considerations. Shape integrated solution portfolios that may include Salesforce core platform capabilities; Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, and related products; MuleSoft and API-led integration; hyperscaler services on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform; data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake; ERP and other enterprise applications. Lead collaborative architecture, discovery, and design sessions that align business, functional, technical, data, security, and operational stakeholders around a feasible path forward. Produce and maintain clear architecture artifacts—including solution visions, capability maps, system context and integration designs, data flows, non-functional requirements, decision records, roadmaps, and phased delivery approaches—that enable teams to act. Assess current-state landscapes, identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and technical debt, and recommend sequenced improvements that balance business value, delivery speed, cost, resilience, security, and maintainability. Guide the technical strategy and integrated delivery of large, multi-workstream programs, including custom development, package configuration, integration, data migration, platform engineering, environment and release management, and change adoption dependencies. Establish lightweight, fit-for-purpose architecture guardrails and design reviews that improve quality, consistency, and reuse while keeping teams moving quickly. Work with account, pursuit, and delivery leaders to shape opportunities, estimate technical work, define delivery approaches, communicate tradeoffs, and build client confidence from early sales through program execution. Lead and mentor solution architects, technical architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams; create alignment across workstreams and resolve complex decisions before they become delivery blockers. Contribute to the growth of Slalom's Enterprise Architecture capability through reusable methods, points of view, accelerators, community building, mentoring, and active knowledge sharing. Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role.What You’ll Bring10+ years of experience in solution, technical, enterprise, or domain architecture roles, including significant experience leading complex technology programs or transformations in a consulting or client-facing environment. Demonstrated ability to lead large, multi-workstream programs from shaping through delivery—connecting business outcomes to a portfolio of technical solutions and coordinating teams across platforms, vendors, and organizational boundaries. Deep Salesforce platform experience, including core CRM capabilities and multiple clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, or comparable Salesforce products; able to determine when Salesforce is the right answer and how it should fit within a broader enterprise landscape. Strong integration architecture experience, including MuleSoft or comparable integration platforms, APIs, event-driven patterns, data synchronization, security, error handling, and operational support considerations. Working depth in one or more hyperscaler platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), and familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable technologies. Experience integrating CRM and digital platforms with ERP, customer data, analytics, identity, commerce, marketing, legacy, and other enterprise systems. Strong command of architectural and delivery concerns including data architecture, security, privacy, identity and access management, scalability, performance, availability, resilience, observability, environment strategy, release management, CI/CD, and operational readiness. Ability to quickly organize cross-functional teams and convert ambiguity into decisions, plans, and work products. Comfortable applying architecture methods pragmatically; values outcomes, clarity, and delivery momentum over rigid framework adherence. Proven consultative and communication skills: able to facilitate executive conversations, explain complex tradeoffs in clear business language, build trust, and tailor materials to the audience. Experience leading technical teams and design reviews, coaching architects and engineers, and raising the quality and consistency of solution delivery. Relevant Salesforce, cloud, integration, data, or architecture certifications are valued. Equivalent experience and demonstrated expertise will be considered. Able to travel up to 50%, based on client and business needs. What Success Looks LikeClients have a clear, credible path from business ambition to an integrated technical solution and a phased delivery plan. Sales and delivery teams make faster, better-informed decisions because architecture is understandable, actionable, and grounded in real program constraints. Solutions across Salesforce, cloud, data, integration, and enterprise applications work together as a coherent portfolio—not a collection of disconnected platform decisions. Teams are aligned, delivery risks are surfaced early, and governance enables momentum without becoming bureaucracy. Slalom's Enterprise Architecture capability becomes more repeatable, more connected to client outcomes, and stronger through the architect's leadership and mentoring. About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: 
East Bay, San Francisco, Silicon Valley:Senior Principal: $222,000–$271,000Director: $260,000–$317,000San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, Seattle, Boston, Houston, New Jersey, New York City, Washington DC, Westchester:Senior Principal: $203,500–$248,500Director: $238,000–$291,000All other locations:Senior Principal: $186,500–$228,000Director: $218,000–$267,000
 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.    We will accept applicants until September 18, or until the position is filled.We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. rows.title: Principal Architect – Microsoft Cloud (Azure, Data & AI)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Role Overview

We are hiring a Microsoft Center of Excellence Lead or a Solutions Technical Leader to define and drive the technical strategy for our Microsoft business globally.

This is a senior, externally facing leadership role at the intersection of:

Executive technology leadershipAzure, Data, and AI architectureStrategic deal shaping and co-innovation with Microsoft

You will act as the technical face of Publicis Sapient to clients and Microsoft, shaping complex pursuits, influencing innovation, and scaling repeatable solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Qualifications

What You Bring :

Experience

12+ years in enterprise architecture, CoE leadership, or senior technical leadership rolesProven track record shaping and winning large, complex transformation dealsExperience operating as a trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders

Microsoft Technical Expertise - 

Hands-on depth across:

Azure platform (infrastructure, platform services, integration, modernization)Data platforms (Fabric, analytics, enterprise data ecosystems)AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, ML, Copilot ecosystem)

Track record delivering:

Enterprise-scale cloud architecturesProduction-grade AI solutionsScalable, repeatable solution patterns

Commercial & Executive Capability

Ability to translate technology into business value, commercial outcomes, and platform growthStrong executive communication and storytelling skillsExperience linking technical strategy to client transformation and Microsoft ecosystem growth

Leadership Profile

Strong cross-industry perspective with pattern recognition and reuseAbility to lead through ambiguity and pioneer new solution spacesProven experience orchestrating global teams and partner ecosystems

Preferred Differentiators

Microsoft certifications (Azure Architect, AI Engineer, Data Engineer)Established relationships across the Microsoft ecosystemExperience with Copilot, GenAI, and agentic AI architecturesProven track record building scalable IP and co-sell solutionsThought leadership across events, publications, or industry forumsIndustry depth in Financial Services, Retail, Healthcare, Energy, or Telecom

Why This Role

Lead and scale Publicis Sapient’s Microsoft Center of Excellence globallyOperate as a senior technical leader shaping strategy, deals, and innovationPartner directly with Microsoft to influence joint solutions and market impactBuild the next generation of Azure + Data + AI + Copilot-driven enterprise transformation

Additional Information

Pay Range: $200,000 - $270,000

The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work itself. Benefits of working here: Flexible vacation policy; time is not limited, allocated, or accrued 16 paid holidays throughout the year Generous parental leave and new parent transition program Tuition reimbursement Corporate gift matching program

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com. Your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a global digital transformation partner that, for more than 30 years, has guided some of the world s largest organisations toward a digitally enabled future, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and Data problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of Next.

Our teams combine deep industry expertise with our SPEED capabilities, Strategy, Product, Experience, Engineering, and Data & AI to tackle the biggest challenges clients are facing today. This is where transformation stops being a buzzword and becomes measurable outcomes for millions of members.

Our 20,000+ professionals in 70 offices worldwide combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses by designing the products and services their customers truly value. Our people are problem-solvers and collaborators, leveraging human ingenuity and AI-driven tools to drive innovation.

Our 20,000+ professionals in 70 offices worldwide combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses by designing the products and services their customers truly value. Our people are problem-solvers and collaborators, leveraging human ingenuity and AI-driven tools to drive innovation.

As a strategic Microsoft partner, we co-innovate to deliver enterprise-scale transformation across the Microsoft Intelligent Cloud, spanning Azure, Data, AI, Security, and Copilot platforms.

rows.title: Enterprise Architect
rows.descriptionText:
Who You’ll Work WithSlalom is seeking an Enterprise Architect who can bring the art of the possible to life across large, complex client programs. This person combines broad technology depth, strong business judgment, and a practical delivery mindset to help clients turn ambitious outcomes into coherent, executable solutions. 
The Enterprise Architect will work across a portfolio of Salesforce, integration, cloud, data, and enterprise applications—not just a single platform—to define a clear technical direction and help teams deliver it. They will be equally credible with executives, product and business leaders, architects, and delivery teams. This is a hands-on consulting role: the architect organizes the right people, resolves difficult tradeoffs, advances sales and delivery, and produces tangible work products that move a program forward. 
In addition to expanding and developing Slalom's Enterprise Architecture capability, this role owns technical visions, target-state architectures, and roadmaps for strategic programs and pursuits. Architecture governance is used as a practical means to accelerate sound decisions and delivery—not as a detached governance function.  What You’ll DoPartner with client executives, business leaders, and delivery teams to understand desired outcomes, business processes, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, constraints, and measures of success. Translate those needs into practical, enterprise-level solution strategies and target-state architectures spanning business, application, integration, data, technology, security, and operating-model considerations. Shape integrated solution portfolios that may include Salesforce core platform capabilities; Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, and related products; MuleSoft and API-led integration; hyperscaler services on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform; data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake; ERP and other enterprise applications. Lead collaborative architecture, discovery, and design sessions that align business, functional, technical, data, security, and operational stakeholders around a feasible path forward. Produce and maintain clear architecture artifacts—including solution visions, capability maps, system context and integration designs, data flows, non-functional requirements, decision records, roadmaps, and phased delivery approaches—that enable teams to act. Assess current-state landscapes, identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and technical debt, and recommend sequenced improvements that balance business value, delivery speed, cost, resilience, security, and maintainability. Guide the technical strategy and integrated delivery of large, multi-workstream programs, including custom development, package configuration, integration, data migration, platform engineering, environment and release management, and change adoption dependencies. Establish lightweight, fit-for-purpose architecture guardrails and design reviews that improve quality, consistency, and reuse while keeping teams moving quickly. Work with account, pursuit, and delivery leaders to shape opportunities, estimate technical work, define delivery approaches, communicate tradeoffs, and build client confidence from early sales through program execution. Lead and mentor solution architects, technical architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams; create alignment across workstreams and resolve complex decisions before they become delivery blockers. Contribute to the growth of Slalom's Enterprise Architecture capability through reusable methods, points of view, accelerators, community building, mentoring, and active knowledge sharing. Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role.What You’ll Bring10+ years of experience in solution, technical, enterprise, or domain architecture roles, including significant experience leading complex technology programs or transformations in a consulting or client-facing environment. Demonstrated ability to lead large, multi-workstream programs from shaping through delivery—connecting business outcomes to a portfolio of technical solutions and coordinating teams across platforms, vendors, and organizational boundaries. Deep Salesforce platform experience, including core CRM capabilities and multiple clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, or comparable Salesforce products; able to determine when Salesforce is the right answer and how it should fit within a broader enterprise landscape. Strong integration architecture experience, including MuleSoft or comparable integration platforms, APIs, event-driven patterns, data synchronization, security, error handling, and operational support considerations. Working depth in one or more hyperscaler platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), and familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable technologies. Experience integrating CRM and digital platforms with ERP, customer data, analytics, identity, commerce, marketing, legacy, and other enterprise systems. Strong command of architectural and delivery concerns including data architecture, security, privacy, identity and access management, scalability, performance, availability, resilience, observability, environment strategy, release management, CI/CD, and operational readiness. Ability to quickly organize cross-functional teams and convert ambiguity into decisions, plans, and work products. Comfortable applying architecture methods pragmatically; values outcomes, clarity, and delivery momentum over rigid framework adherence. Proven consultative and communication skills: able to facilitate executive conversations, explain complex tradeoffs in clear business language, build trust, and tailor materials to the audience. Experience leading technical teams and design reviews, coaching architects and engineers, and raising the quality and consistency of solution delivery. Relevant Salesforce, cloud, integration, data, or architecture certifications are valued. Equivalent experience and demonstrated expertise will be considered. Able to travel up to 50%, based on client and business needs. What Success Looks LikeClients have a clear, credible path from business ambition to an integrated technical solution and a phased delivery plan. Sales and delivery teams make faster, better-informed decisions because architecture is understandable, actionable, and grounded in real program constraints. Solutions across Salesforce, cloud, data, integration, and enterprise applications work together as a coherent portfolio—not a collection of disconnected platform decisions. Teams are aligned, delivery risks are surfaced early, and governance enables momentum without becoming bureaucracy. Slalom's Enterprise Architecture capability becomes more repeatable, more connected to client outcomes, and stronger through the architect's leadership and mentoring. About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges:

rows.title: Associate Director, Product Management
rows.descriptionText:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking an Associate Director, Product Management to join our Digital Nexus Technology organization to lead the KPMG Workbench AI platform.

Responsibilities:

Define and execute the global product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the KPMG Workbench AI gateway, aligning business objectives with emerging AI capabilities across providers like Azure, Google, and AnthropicLead the complete product lifecycle from discovery and ideation to deployment and iterative enhancement, ensuring enterprise-grade reliability, security, cost efficiency, and global scalability across 140 countriesServe as the central liaison between executive leadership, global business stakeholders, and engineering teams, translating strategic organizational goals into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteriaPartner closely with engineering and DevOps teams to prioritize the product backlog, orchestrate release cycles, and oversee platform operational health, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure strategyDrive developer-centric initiatives to accelerate platform usability and adoption, leading the creation of robust technical documentation, client libraries, and seamless onboarding workflows for thousands of global developersOwn product marketing and communications including roadmap transparency, release notes, and SharePoint content while leveraging data-driven platform metrics (adoption, performance, cost) to guide roadmap prioritization and demonstrate business valueAct with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum eight years of recent experience in product management, with a proven track record of managing enterprise-scale technical platforms or complex software products; minimum two years of recent experience in the AI/ML space, with a strong understanding of concepts such as generative AI, RAG, large language models (LLMs), and MLOpsMaster's degree from an accredited college or university or MBA is a plus; minimum of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in computer science, engineering, or a related field is requiredDeep familiarity with cloud-native architectures, API-first design principles, and modern DevOps practices; hands-on experience with platforms like Azure, GCP, or AWS is strongly preferredDemonstrated ability to operate in a highly technical environment, effectively communicating with engineers about architecture, microservices, and infrastructure while translating these concepts for a business audienceExceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams, build consensus among stakeholders, and present a compelling product vision to executives; Experience with product marketing and communications, including managing content on platforms like SharePoint and drafting release announcementsApplicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

KPMG LLP and its subsidiaries (“KPMG”) complies with all local/state regulations regarding displaying salary ranges. If required, the ranges displayed below or via the URL below are specifically for those potential hires who will work in the location(s) listed. Any offered salary is determined based on relevant factors such as applicant's skills, job responsibilities, prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications and market considerations. In addition, KPMG is proud to offer a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, with options designed to help you make the best decisions for yourself, your family, and your lifestyle. Available benefits are based on eligibility. Our Total Rewards package includes a variety of medical and dental plans, vision coverage, disability and life insurance, 401(k) plans, and a robust suite of personal well-being benefits to support your mental health. Depending on job classification, standard work hours, and years of service, KPMG provides Personal Time Off per fiscal year. Additionally, each year KPMG publishes a calendar of holidays to be observed during the year and provides eligible employees two breaks each year where employees will not be required to use Personal Time Off; one is at year end and the other is around the July 4th holiday. Additional details about our benefits can be found towards the bottom of our KPMG US Careers site at Benefits & How We Work.

Follow this link to obtain salary ranges by city outside of CA:

https://kpmg.com/us/en/how-we-work/pay-transparency.html/?id=8173_9_26

This is a senior consulting role for someone who can work across strategy and execution, partner with client leaders, shape product operating models, and help organizations understand how AI can meaningfully improve the way they discover, plan, build, test, launch, and manage products.This role requires flexibility. No two clients will need the exact same thing. Some engagements may focus on product strategy, operating model design, AI-enabled product delivery, portfolio modernization, or leadership alignment. Others may require hands-on support with teams, product leaders, delivery groups, or transformation roadmaps. The right person will be comfortable moving between executive conversations and practical implementation.We’re especially interested in someone who brings together product leadership, AI fluency, consulting experience, and strong delivery judgment. You do not need to have every answer, but you should be curious, credible, and able to help clients separate meaningful AI opportunities from noise.This role is based in Alabama / the Southeast, with flexibility to support clients across the region. Partner with executives, business leaders, technology leaders, and product teams to define how product, operating model, and AI capabilities can improve business outcomes.Shape modern Product Operating Models. Help clients define product structures, value streams, roles and responsibilities, governance, decision rights, planning rhythms, funding models, metrics, and ways of working.Bring AI into the product lifecycle. Help organizations understand where AI can create real value across discovery, research, requirements, backlog refinement, planning, engineering, testing, documentation, analytics, and decision-making.Help clients make practical AI choices. Evaluate product maturity, delivery performance, organizational structures, tooling, governance, team design, portfolio practices, and AI readiness, then turn findings into practical recommendations.Support sales and growth. Help shape pursuits, proposals, solution approaches, client conversations, thought leadership, and reusable Modern Product assets.Build client capability. Create playbooks, frameworks, enablement materials, and practical tools that help clients continue improving after Slalom’s work is complete.Contribute to the Modern Product community. Share market insights, lessons learned, client patterns, AI use cases, and reusable approaches that strengthen how Slalom brings Product and AI solutions to clients.What We’re Looking ForYou may be a great fit if you have:10+ years of experience across product management, product strategy, product operating models, digital transformation, technology delivery, consulting, or related leadership rolesExperience working directly with clients, executives, and senior stakeholders to shape strategy, solve ambiguous problems, and drive measurable outcomesStrong understanding of modern product management, including product strategy, discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, outcome definition, value streams, portfolio alignment, and customer valueExperience designing or improving Product Operating Models, including roles, governance, decision rights, funding, planning, metrics, and team structuresPractical knowledge of AI and Generative AI, including how these capabilities can improve people, process, technology, and data to make adoption successfulThe ability to move comfortably between executive-level strategy and hands-on engagement work with product, technology, and delivery teamsStrong consulting skills, including facilitation, structured problem solving, executive communication, storytelling, relationship building, and ambiguity managementExperience shaping proposals, leading client conversations, developing solution approaches, and contributing to business developmentA flexible mindset and willingness to support a range of Modern Product needs, from product strategy and AI transformation to operating model design and team-level enablementA leadership style grounded in outcomes over outputs, principles over process, and practical progress over rigid frameworksIt’s a Plus If You BringExperience leading product, AI, digital, Agile, or operating model transformations across multiple industries or complex enterprise environmentsExperience with portfolio management, value-stream design, product funding models, AI-enabled delivery practices, or enterprise transformation roadmapsFamiliarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro, Confluence, product portfolio platforms, analytics tools, and modern AI toolsRelevant certifications in product management, Agile, SAFe, Lean, design thinking, AI, cloud, or change managementMost business value.If you’re excited about the intersection of product, AI, operating models, and transformation, and want to help clients modernize how they work and deliver value, we’d love to talk.
